        "contents": "DECLARE_int32(wal_ttl);\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace kvstore {\n\nNebulaStore::~NebulaStore() {\n  stop();\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Cut off the relationship with meta client\";\n  options_.partMan_.reset();\n  bgWorkers_-&gt;stop();\n  bgWorkers_-&gt;wait();\n  storeWorker_-&gt;stop();\n  storeWorker_-&gt;wait();\n  spaces_.clear();\n  spaceListeners_.clear();\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"~NebulaStore()\";\n}\n\nbool NebulaStore::init() {\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Start the raft service...\";\n  bgWorkers_ = std::make_shared&lt;thread::GenericThreadPool&gt;();\n  bgWorkers_-&gt;start(FLAGS_num_workers, \"nebula-bgworkers\");\n  storeWorker_ = std::make_shared&lt;thread::GenericWorker&gt;();\n  CHECK(storeWorker_-&gt;start());\n  snapshot_.reset(new NebulaSnapshotManager(this));\n  raftService_ = raftex::RaftexService::createService(ioPool_, workers_, raftAddr_.port);\n  if (raftService_ == nullptr) {\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Start the raft service failed\";\n    return false;\n  }\n  diskMan_.reset(new DiskManager(options_.dataPaths_, storeWorker_));\n  // todo(doodle): we could support listener and normal storage start at same\n  // instance\n  if (!isListener()) {\n    // TODO(spw): need to refactor, we could load data from local regardless of partManager,\n    // then adjust the data in loadPartFromPartManager.\n    loadPartFromDataPath();\n    loadPartFromPartManager();\n    loadRemoteListenerFromPartManager();\n  } else {\n    loadLocalListenerFromPartManager();\n  }\n\n  storeWorker_-&gt;addDelayTask(FLAGS_clean_wal_interval_secs * 1000, &amp;NebulaStore::cleanWAL, this);\n  storeWorker_-&gt;addRepeatTask(\n      FLAGS_rocksdb_backup_interval_secs * 1000, &amp;NebulaStore::backup, this);\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Register handler...\";\n  options_.partMan_-&gt;registerHandler(this);\n  return true;\n}\n\nvoid NebulaStore::loadPartFromDataPath()",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2020 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#ifndef META_RESTOREPROCESSOR_H_\n#define META_RESTOREPROCESSOR_H_\n\n#include \"kvstore/KVEngine.h\"\n#include \"meta/processors/BaseProcessor.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace meta {\n\n/**\n * @brief Rebuild the host related meta info after ingesting the table backup data to\n *        the new cluster metad KV store.\n *\n *        For example, we have an cluster A which consists of hosts\n *        [ip1:port1, ip2:port2, ip3:port3]. Now we use backup data from cluster A to restore in a\n *        new cluster B which consists of hosts [ip4:port4, ip5:port5, ip6:port6].\n *        Because after ingesting, the meta info has data consists of old addresses,\n *        we should replace the related info with [from, to] pairs:\n *        ip1:port1-&gt;ip4:port4, ip2:port2-&gt;ip5:port5, ip3:port3-&gt;ip6:port6.\n *\n *        Now the related meta info including:\n *        1. part info: graph + part -&gt; part peers list\n *        2. zone info: zone id -&gt; zone hosts list\n *        3. machine info: machine key -&gt; \"\"\n *\n */\nclass RestoreProcessor : public BaseProcessor&lt;cpp2::RestoreMetaResp&gt; {\n public:\n  static RestoreProcessor* instance(kvstore::KVStore* kvstore) {\n    return new RestoreProcessor(kvstore);\n  }\n  void process(const cpp2::RestoreMetaReq&amp; req);\n\n private:\n  explicit RestoreProcessor(kvstore::KVStore* kvstore)\n      : BaseProcessor&lt;cpp2::RestoreMetaResp&gt;(kvstore) {}\n\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode replaceHostInPartition(kvstore::WriteBatch* batch,\n                                                 std::map&lt;HostAddr, HostAddr&gt;&amp; hostMap);\n\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode replaceHostInZone(kvstore::WriteBatch* batch,\n                                            std::map&lt;HostAddr, HostAddr&gt;&amp; hostMap);\n\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode replaceHostInMachine(kvstore::WriteBatch* batch,\n                                               std::map&lt;HostAddr, HostAddr&gt;&amp; hostMap);\n};\n\n}  // namespace meta\n}  // namespace nebula\n\n#endif  // META_RESTOREPROCESSOR_H_",

        "contents": "void RocksEngine::openBackupEngine(GraphSpaceID spaceId) {\n  // If backup dir is not empty, set backup related options\n  if (FLAGS_rocksdb_table_format == \"PlainTable\" &amp;&amp; !FLAGS_rocksdb_backup_dir.empty()) {\n    backupPath_ =\n        folly::stringPrintf(\"%s/rocksdb_backup/%d\", FLAGS_rocksdb_backup_dir.c_str(), spaceId);\n    if (FileUtils::fileType(backupPath_.c_str()) == FileType::NOTEXIST) {\n      if (!FileUtils::makeDir(backupPath_)) {\n        LOG(FATAL) &lt;&lt; \"makeDir \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_ &lt;&lt; \" failed\";\n      }\n    }\n    rocksdb::BackupEngine* backupDb;\n    rocksdb::BackupEngineOptions backupOptions(backupPath_);\n    backupOptions.backup_log_files = false;\n    auto status = rocksdb::BackupEngine::Open(rocksdb::Env::Default(), backupOptions, &amp;backupDb);\n    CHECK(status.ok()) &lt;&lt; status.ToString();\n    backupDb_.reset(backupDb);\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"open plain table backup engine on \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_;\n\n    std::string dataPath = folly::stringPrintf(\"%s/data\", dataPath_.c_str());\n    auto walDir = dataPath;\n    if (!FLAGS_rocksdb_wal_dir.empty()) {\n      walDir = folly::stringPrintf(\"%s/rocksdb_wal/%d\", FLAGS_rocksdb_wal_dir.c_str(), spaceId);\n    } else {\n      LOG(WARNING) &lt;&lt; \"rocksdb wal is stored with data. If data_path is on tmpfs, the wal is \"\n                      \"volatile as well\";\n    }\n\n    rocksdb::RestoreOptions restoreOptions;\n    restoreOptions.keep_log_files = true;\n    status = backupDb_-&gt;RestoreDBFromLatestBackup(dataPath, walDir, restoreOptions);\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"try to restore from backup path \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_;\n    if (status.IsNotFound()) {\n      LOG(WARNING) &lt;&lt; \"no valid backup found\";\n      return;\n    } else if (!status.ok()) {\n      LOG(FATAL) &lt;&lt; status.ToString();\n    }\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"restore from latest backup successfully\"\n              &lt;&lt; \", backup path \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_ &lt;&lt; \", wal path \" &lt;&lt; walDir &lt;&lt; \", data path \"\n              &lt;&lt; dataPath;\n  }\n}\n\nnebula::cpp2::ErrorCode",

        "contents": "nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode BalanceJobExecutor::recovery() {\n  if (kvstore_ == nullptr) {\n    return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED;\n  }\n  auto* store = static_cast&lt;kvstore::NebulaStore*&gt;(kvstore_);\n  if (!store-&gt;isLeader(kDefaultSpaceId, kDefaultPartId)) {\n    // We need to check whether is leader or not, otherwise we would failed to\n    // persist state of BalancePlan and BalanceTask, so we just reject request\n    // if not leader.\n    return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_LEADER_CHANGED;\n  }\n\n  auto jobKey = MetaKeyUtils::jobKey(space_, jobId_);\n  std::string value;\n  auto retCode = kvstore_-&gt;get(kDefaultSpaceId, kDefaultPartId, jobKey, &amp;value);\n  if (retCode != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Can't access kvstore, ret = \" &lt;&lt; apache::thrift::util::enumNameSafe(retCode);\n    return retCode;\n  }\n  auto optJobRet = JobDescription::makeJobDescription(jobKey, value);\n  auto optJob = nebula::value(optJobRet);\n  plan_.reset(new BalancePlan(optJob, kvstore_, adminClient_));\n\n  auto recRet = plan_-&gt;recovery();\n  if (recRet != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n    plan_.reset(nullptr);\n    return recRet;\n  }\n  return plan_-&gt;saveInStore();\n}\n\nnebula::cpp2::ErrorCode BalanceJobExecutor::finish(bool) {\n  plan_.reset(nullptr);\n  return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED;\n}\n\nnebula::cpp2::ErrorCode BalanceJobExecutor::save(const std::string&amp; k, const std::string&amp; v) {\n  std::vector&lt;kvstore::KV&gt; data{std::make_pair(k, v)};\n  folly::Baton&lt;true, std::atomic&gt; baton;\n  auto rc = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED;\n  kvstore_-&gt;asyncMultiPut(\n      kDefaultSpaceId, kDefaultPartId, std::move(data), [&amp;](nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode code) {\n        rc = code;\n        baton.post();\n      });\n  baton.wait();\n  return rc;\n}\n\nvoid BalanceJobExecutor::insertOneTask",

        "contents": "t4: 后台线程应用 log[10]\n    lastApplied = 10\n    \nt5: 此时 commitIndex == lastApplied == 10\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 什么时候会有差距？\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. 正常情况: 应用日志需要时间（状态机操作可能慢）\n   commitIndex 先更新，lastApplied 追赶\n\n2. 重启后: commitIndex 可以从 Leader 那里快速获取\n          lastApplied 需要重新回放日志（或从快照恢复）\n\n3. 高负载: 日志提交很快，但应用跟不上\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**结论**：正常稳定运行时它们基本相等，但设计上允许有滞后。\n\n---\n\n## 问题 5：中间日志丢失怎么办？\n\n### 首先：正常情况下不会\"中间丢失\"\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nRaft 日志是连续的，不允许有\"空洞\":\n  log = [1, 2, 3, _, 5, 6]  ← 这种情况不应该存在\n\n原因:\n- 持久化保证落盘后不丢\n- AppendEntries 的一致性检查保证连续性\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 如果真的发生了（硬件故障、磁盘损坏）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n情况: 节点 B 的日志因为磁盘错误丢失了一部分\n\nLeader 发送 AppendEntries:\n  prevLogIndex = 100\n  prevLogTerm = 5\n  entries = [101, 102]\n\nFollower B 检查:\n  log[100] 不存在或 term 不匹配\n  → 返回 success = false\n\nLeader 处理:\n  nextIndex[B]--  → 重试 prevLogIndex = 99\n  继续递减，直到找到匹配点\n  或者 nextIndex 小于 Leader 的日志起点 → 发送 InstallSnapshot\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### InstallSnapshot 兜底\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n极端情况:\n  Leader 日志从 index 1000 开始（之前的都快照了）\n  Follower B 日志损坏，完全丢失\n\n流程:\n1. Leader 不断递减 nextIndex[B]\n2. 发现 nextIndex[B] &lt; 1000（Leader 没有这么旧的日志）\n3. Leader 发送 InstallSnapshot RPC\n4. Follower B 安装快照，重建状态\n5. 继续正常的日志同步\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 总结\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ 日志丢失的恢复机制                          │\n├────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│ 轻度: AppendEntries 回退重传               │",

        "contents": " {\n  auto addrs = network::NetworkUtils::toHosts(FLAGS_meta_server_addrs);\n  if (!addrs.ok()) {\n    return addrs.status();\n  }\n\n  meta::MetaClientOptions options;\n  options.serviceName_ = \"graph\";\n  options.skipConfig_ = FLAGS_local_config;\n  options.role_ = meta::cpp2::HostRole::GRAPH;\n  options.localHost_ = hostAddr;\n  options.gitInfoSHA_ = gitInfoSha();\n  options.rootPath_ = boost::filesystem::current_path().string();\n\n  metaClient_ = std::make_unique&lt;meta::MetaClient&gt;(ioExecutor, std::move(addrs.value()), options);\n\n  // Load data try 3 time\n  bool loadDataOk = metaClient_-&gt;waitForMetadReady(3);\n  if (!loadDataOk) {\n    // Resort to retrying in the background\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Failed to wait for meta service ready synchronously.\";\n    return Status::Error(\"Failed to wait for meta service ready synchronously.\");\n  }\n\n  // Wait meta to sync the timezone configuration\n  // Initialize the global timezone, it's only used for datetime type compute\n  // won't affect the process timezone.\n  auto status = nebula::time::Timezone::initializeGlobalTimezone();\n  if (!status.ok()) {\n    return status;\n  }\n\n  sessionManager_ = std::make_unique&lt;GraphSessionManager&gt;(metaClient_.get(), hostAddr);\n  auto initSessionMgrStatus = sessionManager_-&gt;init();\n  if (!initSessionMgrStatus.ok()) {\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Failed to initialize session manager: \" &lt;&lt; initSessionMgrStatus.toString();\n    return Status::Error(\"Failed to initialize session manager: %s\",\n                         initSessionMgrStatus.toString().c_str());\n  }\n\n  queryEngine_ = std::make_unique&lt;QueryEngine&gt;();\n  return queryEngine_-&gt;init(std::move(ioExecutor), metaClient_.get());\n}\n\nfolly::Future&lt;AuthResponse&gt; GraphService::future_authenticate",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./src/kvstore/wal/FileBasedWal.cpp",
        "range": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "void FileBasedWal::scanLastWal(WalFileInfoPtr info, LogID firstId) {\n  auto* path = info-&gt;path();\n  int32_t fd = open(path, O_RDWR);\n  if (fd &lt; 0) {\n    LOG(FATAL) &lt;&lt; \"Failed to open file \\\"\" &lt;&lt; path &lt;&lt; \"\\\" (errno: \" &lt;&lt; errno\n               &lt;&lt; \"): \" &lt;&lt; strerror(errno);\n  }\n\n  LogID curLogId = firstId;\n  size_t pos = 0;\n  LogID id = 0;\n  TermID term = 0;\n  int32_t head = 0;\n  int32_t foot = 0;\n  while (true) {\n    // Read the log Id\n    if (pread(fd, &amp;id, sizeof(LogID), pos) != sizeof(LogID)) {\n      break;\n    }\n\n    if (id != curLogId) {\n      LOG(WARNING) &lt;&lt;         "contents": "// efficient.\nvoid GraphSessionManager::reclaimExpiredSessions() {\n  DCHECK_GT(FLAGS_session_idle_timeout_secs, 0);\n  if (FLAGS_session_idle_timeout_secs == 0) {\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Program should not reach here, session_idle_timeout_secs should be an integer \"\n                  \"between 1 and 604800\";\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (activeSessions_.empty()) {\n    return;\n  }\n\n  FVLOG3(\"Try to reclaim expired sessions out of %lu ones\", activeSessions_.size());\n  std::vector&lt;SessionID&gt; expiredSessions;\n\n  // collect expired sessions\n  for (const auto&amp; iter : activeSessions_) {\n    int32_t idleSecs = iter.second-&gt;idleSeconds();\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; \"SessionId: \" &lt;&lt; iter.first &lt;&lt; \", idleSecs: \" &lt;&lt; idleSecs;\n    if (idleSecs &lt; FLAGS_session_idle_timeout_secs) {\n      continue;\n    }\n    FLOG_INFO(\"ClientSession %ld has expired\", iter.first);\n\n    expiredSessions.emplace_back(iter.first);\n    // TODO: Disconnect the connection of the session\n  }\n\n  // Remove expired sessions from meta server\n  if (expiredSessions.empty()) {\n    return;\n  }\n\n  auto resp = metaClient_-&gt;removeSessions(std::move(expiredSessions)).get();\n  if (!resp.ok()) {\n    // TODO: Handle cases where the delete client failed\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Remove session failed: \" &lt;&lt; resp.status();\n    return;\n  }\n\n  auto killedSessions = resp.value().get_removed_session_ids();\n  // Remove expired sessions from local cache\n  removeSessionFromLocalCache(killedSessions);\n}\n\nvoid GraphSessionManager::updateSessionsToMeta()",

Meta server is required\";\n  clientsMan_ = std::make_shared&lt;thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;cpp2::MetaServiceAsyncClient&gt;&gt;(\n      FLAGS_enable_ssl || FLAGS_enable_meta_ssl);\n  updateActive();\n  updateLeader();\n  bgThread_ = std::make_unique&lt;thread::GenericWorker&gt;();\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Create meta client to \" &lt;&lt; active_;\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; folly::sformat(\n      \"root path: {}, data path size: {}\", options_.rootPath_, options_.dataPaths_.size());\n}\n\nMetaClient::~MetaClient() {\n  notifyStop();\n  stop();\n  delete metadata_.load();\n  VLOG(3) &lt;&lt; \"~MetaClient\";\n}\n\n#ifdef BUILD_STANDALONE\nStatusOr&lt;bool&gt; MetaClient::checkLocalMachineRegistered() {\n  auto ret = heartbeat().get();\n  if (!ret.ok()) {\n    if (ret.status().toString() == \"Machine not existed!\") {\n      return false;\n    }\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Check register failed: \" &lt;&lt; ret.status();\n    return Status::Error(\"Check register failed!\");\n  }\n  return true;\n}\n#endif\n\nbool MetaClient::isMetadReady()",

\" in DbUpgrader run end\";\n}\n\nvoid DbUpgrader::doSpace() {\n  std::chrono::milliseconds take_dura{10};\n  if (auto UpSpace = spaceQueue_.try_take_for(take_dura)) {\n    auto upgraderSpaceIter = *UpSpace;\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Upgrade from path \" &lt;&lt; upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;srcPath_ &lt;&lt; \" space id \"\n              &lt;&lt; upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;entry_ &lt;&lt; \" to path \" &lt;&lt; upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;dstPath_\n              &lt;&lt; \" begin\";\n    if (FLAGS_upgrade_version == \"1:2\") {\n      upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;doProcessV1();\n    } else if (FLAGS_upgrade_version == \"2RC:2\") {\n      upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;doProcessV2();\n    } else if (FLAGS_upgrade_version == \"2:3\") {\n      upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;doProcessV3();\n    } else {\n      LOG(FATAL) &lt;&lt; \"error upgrade version \" &lt;&lt; FLAGS_upgrade_version;\n    }\n\n    auto ret = upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;copyWal();\n    if (!ret) {\n      LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Copy space id \" &lt;&lt; upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;entry_ &lt;&lt; \" wal file failed\";\n    } else {\n      LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Copy space id \" &lt;&lt; upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;entry_ &lt;&lt; \" wal file success\";\n    }\n\n    if (FLAGS_compactions) {\n      upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;doCompaction();\n    }\n\n    auto unFinishedSpace = --unFinishedSpace_;\n    if (unFinishedSpace == 0) {\n      // all spaces has finished\n      LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Upgrade last space: \" &lt;&lt; upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;entry_ &lt;&lt; \" from \"\n                &lt;&lt; upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;srcPath_ &lt;&lt; \" to path \" &lt;&lt; upgraderSpaceIter-&gt;dstPath_\n                &lt;&lt; \" end\";\n    } else {\n      pool_-&gt;add(std::bind(&amp;DbUpgrader::doSpace, this));\n    }\n  } else {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Upgrade from path \" &lt;&lt; srcPath_ &lt;&lt; \" to path \" &lt;&lt; dstPath_ &lt;&lt; \" end\";\n  }\n}\n\n}  // namespace storage\n}  // namespace nebula",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2020 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#ifndef META_RESTOREPROCESSOR_H_\n#define META_RESTOREPROCESSOR_H_\n\n#include \"kvstore/KVEngine.h\"\n#include \"meta/processors/BaseProcessor.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace meta {\n\n/**\n * @brief Rebuild the host related meta info after ingesting the table backup data to\n *        the new cluster metad KV store.\n *\n *        For example, we have an cluster A which consists of hosts\n *        [ip1:port1, ip2:port2, ip3:port3]. Now we use backup data from cluster A to restore in a\n *        new cluster B which consists of hosts [ip4:port4, ip5:port5, ip6:port6].\n *        Because after ingesting, the meta info has data consists of old addresses,\n *        we should replace the related info with [from, to] pairs:\n *        ip1:port1-&gt;ip4:port4, ip2:port2-&gt;ip5:port5, ip3:port3-&gt;ip6:port6.\n *\n *        Now the related meta info including:\n *        1. part info: graph + part -&gt; part peers list\n *        2. zone info: zone id -&gt; zone hosts list\n *        3. machine info: machine key -&gt; \"\"\n *\n */\nclass RestoreProcessor : public BaseProcessor&lt;cpp2::RestoreMetaResp&gt; {\n public:\n  static RestoreProcessor* instance(kvstore::KVStore* kvstore) {\n    return new RestoreProcessor(kvstore);\n  }\n  void process(const cpp2::RestoreMetaReq&amp; req);\n\n private:\n  explicit RestoreProcessor(kvstore::KVStore* kvstore)\n      : BaseProcessor&lt;cpp2::RestoreMetaResp&gt;(kvstore) {}\n\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode replaceHostInPartition(kvstore::WriteBatch* batch,\n                                                 std::map&lt;HostAddr, HostAddr&gt;&amp; hostMap);\n\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode replaceHostInZone(kvstore::WriteBatch* batch,\n                                            std::map&lt;HostAddr, HostAddr&gt;&amp; hostMap);\n\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode replaceHostInMachine(kvstore::WriteBatch* batch,\n                                               std::map&lt;HostAddr, HostAddr&gt;&amp; hostMap);\n};\n\n}  // namespace meta\n}  // namespace nebula\n\n#endif  // META_RESTOREPROCESSOR_H_",

\"Zone prefix failed, error: \" &lt;&lt; apache::thrift::util::enumNameSafe(retCode);\n    return retCode;\n  }\n  auto iter = nebula::value(iterRet).get();\n\n  // Explicit use of the zone feature is disabled, and a zone can only have one host.\n  std::unordered_map&lt;std::string, std::string&gt;         "contents": "void RestoreProcessor::process(const cpp2::RestoreMetaReq&amp; req) {\n  auto files = req.get_files();\n  if (files.empty()) {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"restore must contain the sst file.\";\n    handleErrorCode(nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RESTORE_FAILURE);\n    onFinished();\n    return;\n  }\n\n  auto ret = kvstore_-&gt;restoreFromFiles(kDefaultSpaceId, files);\n  if (ret != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Failed to restore file\";\n    handleErrorCode(nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RESTORE_FAILURE);\n    onFinished();\n    return;\n  }\n\n  auto batch = kvstore_-&gt;startBatchWrite();\n  auto replaceHosts = req.get_hosts();\n  if (!replaceHosts.empty()) {\n    std::map&lt;HostAddr, HostAddr&gt; hostMap;\n    for (auto h : replaceHosts) {\n      if (h.get_from_host() == h.get_to_host()) {\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      hostMap[h.get_from_host()] = h.get_to_host();\n    }\n\n    if (!hostMap.empty()) {\n      auto result = replaceHostInPartition(batch.get(), hostMap);\n      if (result != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n        LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"replaceHost in partition fails when recovered\";\n        handleErrorCode(result);\n        onFinished();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      result = replaceHostInZone(batch.get(), hostMap);\n      if (result != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n        LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"replaceHost in zone fails when recovered\";\n        handleErrorCode(result);\n        onFinished();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      result = replaceHostInMachine(batch.get(), hostMap);\n      if (result != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n        LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"replaceHost in machine fails when recovered\";\n        handleErrorCode(result);\n        onFinished();\n        return;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  for (auto&amp; f : files) {\n    unlink(f.c_str());\n  }\n\n  ret = kvstore_-&gt;batchWriteWithoutReplicator(kDefaultSpaceId, std::move(batch));\n  handleErrorCode(ret);\n  onFinished();\n}\n\n}  // namespace meta\n}  // namespace nebula",

        "contents": "Status MetaVersionMan::doUpgradeV2ToV3(kvstore::KVEngine* engine) {\n  MetaDataUpgrade upgrader(engine);\n  // Step 1: Upgrade HeartBeat into machine list\n  {\n    // collect all hosts association with zone\n    std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt; zoneHosts;\n    const auto&amp; zonePrefix = MetaKeyUtils::zonePrefix();\n    std::unique_ptr&lt;kvstore::KVIterator&gt; zoneIter;\n    auto code = engine-&gt;prefix(zonePrefix, &amp;zoneIter);\n    if (code != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n      LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Get active hosts failed\";\n      return Status::Error(\"Get hosts failed\");\n    }\n\n    while (zoneIter-&gt;valid()) {\n      auto hosts = MetaKeyUtils::parseZoneHosts(zoneIter-&gt;val());\n      if (!hosts.empty()) {\n        zoneHosts.insert(zoneHosts.end(), hosts.begin(), hosts.end());\n      }\n      zoneIter-&gt;next();\n    }\n\n    const auto&amp; prefix = MetaKeyUtils::hostPrefix();\n    std::unique_ptr&lt;kvstore::KVIterator&gt; iter;\n    code = engine-&gt;prefix(prefix, &amp;iter);\n    if (code != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n      LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Get active hosts failed\";\n      return Status::Error(\"Get hosts failed\");\n    }\n\n    std::vector&lt;kvstore::KV&gt; data;\n    while (iter-&gt;valid()) {\n      auto info = HostInfo::decode(iter-&gt;val());\n\n      if (info.role_ == meta::cpp2::HostRole::STORAGE) {\n        // Save the machine information\n        auto host = MetaKeyUtils::parseHostKey(iter-&gt;key());\n        auto machineKey = MetaKeyUtils::machineKey(host.host, host.port);\n        data.emplace_back(std::move(machineKey), \"\");\n\n        auto hostIt = std::find(zoneHosts.begin(), zoneHosts.end(), host);\n        if (hostIt == zoneHosts.end()) {\n          // Save the zone information\n          auto zoneName = folly::stringPrintf(\"default_zone_%s_%d\", host.host.c_str(), host.port);\n          auto zoneKey = MetaKeyUtils::zoneKey(std::move(zoneName));\n          auto zoneVal = MetaKeyUtils::zoneVal({host});\n          data.emplace_back(std::move(zoneKey), std::move(zoneVal));\n        }\n      }\n      iter-&gt;next();\n    }\n    auto status = upgrader.saveMachineAndZone(std::move(data));\n    if (!status.ok()) {\n      LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; status;\n      return status;\n    }",

        "contents": "  static ClusterID getClusterIdFromKV(kvstore::KVStore* kv, const std::string&amp; key) {\n    CHECK_NOTNULL(kv);\n    std::string value;\n    auto code = kv-&gt;get(0, 0, key, &amp;value, true);\n    if (code == nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_KEY_NOT_FOUND) {\n      LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"There is no clusterId existed in kvstore!\";\n      return 0;\n    } else if (code == nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n      if (value.size() != sizeof(ClusterID)) {\n        LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Bad clusterId \" &lt;&lt; value;\n        return 0;\n      }\n      return *reinterpret_cast&lt;const ClusterID*&gt;(value.data());\n    } else {\n      LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Error in kvstore, err \" &lt;&lt; static_cast&lt;int32_t&gt;(code);\n      return 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Save cluster id into kvStore\n   *\n   * @param kv\n   * @param key\n   * @param clusterId\n   * @return\n   */\n  static bool persistInKV(kvstore::KVStore* kv, const std::string&amp; key, ClusterID clusterId) {\n    CHECK_NOTNULL(kv);\n    std::vector&lt;kvstore::KV&gt; data;\n    data.emplace_back(key, std::string(reinterpret_cast&lt;char*&gt;(&amp;clusterId), sizeof(ClusterID)));\n    bool ret = true;\n    folly::Baton&lt;true, std::atomic&gt; baton;\n    kv-&gt;asyncMultiPut(0, 0, std::move(data), [&amp;](nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode code) {\n      if (code != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n        LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Put failed, error \" &lt;&lt; static_cast&lt;int32_t&gt;(code);\n        ret = false;\n      } else {\n        LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Put key \" &lt;&lt; key &lt;&lt; \", val \" &lt;&lt; clusterId;\n      }\n      baton.post();\n    });\n    baton.wait();\n    return ret;\n  }\n};\n\n}  // namespace meta\n}  // namespace nebula\n\n#endif  // META_CLUSTERIDMAN_H_",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2021 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#include \"meta/processors/zone/MergeZoneProcessor.h\"\n\n#include \"kvstore/LogEncoder.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace meta {\n\nvoid MergeZoneProcessor::process(const cpp2::MergeZoneReq&amp; req) {\n  folly::SharedMutex::WriteHolder holder(LockUtils::lock());\n\n  auto zones = req.get_zones();\n\n  // Confirm that the parameter is not empty.\n  if (zones.empty()) {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Zones is empty\";\n    handleErrorCode(nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_INVALID_PARM);\n    onFinished();\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (zones.size() == 1) {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Only one zone is no need to merge\";\n    handleErrorCode(nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_INVALID_PARM);\n    onFinished();\n    return;\n  }\n\n  // Confirm that there are no duplicates in the parameters.\n  if (std::unique(zones.begin(), zones.end()) != zones.end()) {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Zones have duplicated element\";\n    handleErrorCode(nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_INVALID_PARM);\n    onFinished();\n    return;\n  }\n\n  auto zoneName = req.get_zone_name();\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode code = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED;\n  // Ensure that all zone to be merged exist\n  for (auto&amp; zone : zones) {\n    auto zoneKey = MetaKeyUtils::zoneKey(zone);\n    auto zoneValueRet = doGet(std::move(zoneKey));\n    if (!nebula::ok(zoneValueRet)) {\n      code = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_ZONE_NOT_FOUND;\n      LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt;         "contents": "void RocksEngine::openBackupEngine(GraphSpaceID spaceId) {\n  // If backup dir is not empty, set backup related options\n  if (FLAGS_rocksdb_table_format == \"PlainTable\" &amp;&amp; !FLAGS_rocksdb_backup_dir.empty()) {\n    backupPath_ =\n        folly::stringPrintf(\"%s/rocksdb_backup/%d\", FLAGS_rocksdb_backup_dir.c_str(), spaceId);\n    if (FileUtils::fileType(backupPath_.c_str()) == FileType::NOTEXIST) {\n      if (!FileUtils::makeDir(backupPath_)) {\n        LOG(FATAL) &lt;&lt; \"makeDir \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_ &lt;&lt; \" failed\";\n      }\n    }\n    rocksdb::BackupEngine* backupDb;\n    rocksdb::BackupEngineOptions backupOptions(backupPath_);\n    backupOptions.backup_log_files = false;\n    auto status = rocksdb::BackupEngine::Open(rocksdb::Env::Default(), backupOptions, &amp;backupDb);\n    CHECK(status.ok()) &lt;&lt; status.ToString();\n    backupDb_.reset(backupDb);\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"open plain table backup engine on \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_;\n\n    std::string dataPath = folly::stringPrintf(\"%s/data\", dataPath_.c_str());\n    auto walDir = dataPath;\n    if (!FLAGS_rocksdb_wal_dir.empty()) {\n      walDir = folly::stringPrintf(\"%s/rocksdb_wal/%d\", FLAGS_rocksdb_wal_dir.c_str(), spaceId);\n    } else {\n      LOG(WARNING) &lt;&lt; \"rocksdb wal is stored with data. If data_path is on tmpfs, the wal is \"\n                      \"volatile as well\";\n    }\n\n    rocksdb::RestoreOptions restoreOptions;\n    restoreOptions.keep_log_files = true;\n    status = backupDb_-&gt;RestoreDBFromLatestBackup(dataPath, walDir, restoreOptions);\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"try to restore from backup path \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_;\n    if (status.IsNotFound()) {\n      LOG(WARNING) &lt;&lt; \"no valid backup found\";\n      return;\n    } else if (!status.ok()) {\n      LOG(FATAL) &lt;&lt; status.ToString();\n    }\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"restore from latest backup successfully\"\n              &lt;&lt; \", backup path \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_ &lt;&lt; \", wal path \" &lt;&lt; walDir &lt;&lt; \", data path \"\n              &lt;&lt; dataPath;\n  }\n}\n\nnebula::cpp2::ErrorCode",

        "contents": "void FileBasedWal::scanLastWal(WalFileInfoPtr info, LogID firstId) {\n  auto* path = info-&gt;path();\n  int32_t fd = open(path, O_RDWR);\n  if (fd &lt; 0) {\n    LOG(FATAL) &lt;&lt; \"Failed to open file \\\"\" &lt;&lt; path &lt;&lt; \"\\\" (errno: \" &lt;&lt; errno\n               &lt;&lt; \"): \" &lt;&lt; strerror(errno);\n  }\n\n  LogID curLogId = firstId;\n  size_t pos = 0;\n  LogID id = 0;\n  TermID term = 0;\n  int32_t head = 0;\n  int32_t foot = 0;\n  while (true) {\n    // Read the log Id\n    if (pread(fd, &amp;id, sizeof(LogID), pos) != sizeof(LogID)) {\n      break;\n    }\n\n    if (id != curLogId) {\n      LOG(WARNING) &lt;&lt; \"LogId is not consistent \" &lt;&lt; id &lt;&lt; \" \" &lt;&lt; curLogId;\n      break;\n    }\n\n    // Read the term Id\n    if (pread(fd, &amp;term, sizeof(TermID), pos + sizeof(LogID)) != sizeof(TermID)) {\n      break;\n    }\n\n    // Read the message length\n    if (pread(fd, &amp;head, sizeof(int32_t), pos + sizeof(LogID) + sizeof(TermID)) !=\n        sizeof(int32_t)) {\n      break;\n    }\n\n    if (pread(fd,\n              &amp;foot,\n              sizeof(int32_t),\n              pos + sizeof(LogID) + sizeof(TermID) + sizeof(int32_t) + sizeof(ClusterID) + head) !=\n        sizeof(int32_t)) {\n      break;\n    }\n\n    if (head != foot) {\n      LOG(WARNING) &lt;&lt; \"Message size doesn't match: \" &lt;&lt; head &lt;&lt; \" != \" &lt;&lt; foot;\n      break;\n    }\n\n    info-&gt;setLastTerm(term);\n    info-&gt;setLastId(id);\n\n    // Move to the next log\n    pos += sizeof(LogID) + sizeof(TermID) + sizeof(ClusterID) + sizeof(int32_t) + head +\n           sizeof(int32_t);\n\n    ++curLogId;\n  }\n\n  if (0 &lt;         },
        "contents": "bool FileBasedWal::rollbackToLog(LogID id) {\n  if (id &lt; firstLogId_ - 1 || id &gt; lastLogId_) {\n    VLOG(4) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Rollback target id \" &lt;&lt; id &lt;&lt; \" is not in the range of [\" &lt;&lt; firstLogId_\n            &lt;&lt; \",\" &lt;&lt; lastLogId_ &lt;&lt; \"] of WAL\";\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  folly::RWSpinLock::WriteHolder holder(rollbackLock_);\n  //-----------------------\n  // 1. Roll back WAL files\n  //-----------------------\n\n  // First close the current file\n  closeCurrFile();\n\n  {\n    std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; g(walFilesMutex_);\n\n    if (!walFiles_.empty()) {\n      auto it = walFiles_.upper_bound(id);\n      // We need to remove wal files whose entire log range\n      // are rolled back\n      while (it != walFiles_.end()) {\n        // Need to remove the file\n        VLOG(4) &lt;&lt; \"Removing file \" &lt;&lt; it-&gt;second-&gt;path();\n        unlink(it-&gt;second-&gt;path());\n        it = walFiles_.erase(it);\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (walFiles_.empty()) {\n      // All WAL files are gone\n      CHECK(id == firstLogId_ - 1 || id == 0);\n      firstLogId_ = 0;\n      lastLogId_ = 0;\n      lastLogTerm_ = 0;\n    } else {\n      VLOG(4) &lt;&lt; \"Roll back to log \" &lt;&lt; id &lt;&lt; \", the last WAL file is now \\\"\"\n              &lt;&lt; walFiles_.rbegin()-&gt;second-&gt;path() &lt;&lt; \"\\\"\";\n      rollbackInFile(walFiles_.rbegin()-&gt;second, id);\n      CHECK_EQ(lastLogId_, id);\n      CHECK_EQ(walFiles_.rbegin()-&gt;second-&gt;lastId(), id);\n    }\n  }\n\n  //------------------------------\n  // 2.         "contents": "t4: 后台线程应用 log[10]\n    lastApplied = 10\n    \nt5: 此时 commitIndex == lastApplied == 10\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 什么时候会有差距？\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. 正常情况: 应用日志需要时间（状态机操作可能慢）\n   commitIndex 先更新，lastApplied 追赶\n\n2. 重启后: commitIndex 可以从 Leader 那里快速获取\n          lastApplied 需要重新回放日志（或从快照恢复）\n\n3. 高负载: 日志提交很快，但应用跟不上\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**结论**：正常稳定运行时它们基本相等，但设计上允许有滞后。\n\n---\n\n## 问题 5：中间日志丢失怎么办？\n\n### 首先：正常情况下不会\"中间丢失\"\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nRaft 日志是连续的，不允许有\"空洞\":\n  log = [1, 2, 3, _, 5, 6]  ← 这种情况不应该存在\n\n原因:\n- 持久化保证落盘后不丢\n- AppendEntries 的一致性检查保证连续性\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 如果真的发生了（硬件故障、磁盘损坏）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n情况: 节点 B 的日志因为磁盘错误丢失了一部分\n\nLeader 发送 AppendEntries:\n  prevLogIndex = 100\n  prevLogTerm = 5\n  entries = [101, 102]\n\nFollower B 检查:\n  log[100] 不存在或 term 不匹配\n  → 返回 success = false\n\nLeader 处理:\n  nextIndex[B]--  → 重试 prevLogIndex = 99\n  继续递减，直到找到匹配点\n  或者 nextIndex 小于 Leader 的日志起点 → 发送 InstallSnapshot\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### InstallSnapshot 兜底\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n极端情况:\n  Leader 日志从 index 1000 开始（之前的都快照了）\n  Follower B 日志损坏，完全丢失\n\n流程:\n1. Leader 不断递减 nextIndex[B]\n2. 发现 nextIndex[B] &lt; 1000（Leader 没有这么旧的日志）\n3. Leader 发送 InstallSnapshot RPC\n4. Follower B 安装快照，重建状态\n5. 继续正常的日志同步\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 总结\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ 日志丢失的恢复机制                          │\n├────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│ 轻度: AppendEntries 回退重传               │",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "namespace nebula::meta {\nconst std::string kClusterIdKey = \"__meta_cluster_id_key__\";  // NOLINT\n}  // namespace nebula::meta\n\nnebula::ClusterID gClusterId = 0;\nnebula::ClusterID&amp; metaClusterId() {\n  return gClusterId;\n}\n\nstd::unique_ptr&lt;nebula::kvstore::KVStore&gt; initKV(std::vector&lt;nebula::HostAddr&gt; peers,\n                                                 nebula::HostAddr localhost) {\n  auto partMan = std::make_unique&lt;nebula::kvstore::MemPartManager&gt;();\n  // The meta server has only one space (0), one part (0)\n  partMan-&gt;addPart(nebula::kDefaultSpaceId, nebula::kDefaultPartId, std::move(peers));\n#ifndef BUILD_STANDALONE\n  int32_t numMetaIoThreads = FLAGS_num_io_threads;\n  int32_t numMetaWorkerThreads = FLAGS_num_worker_threads;\n#else\n  int32_t numMetaIoThreads = FLAGS_meta_num_io_threads;\n  int32_t numMetaWorkerThreads = FLAGS_meta_num_worker_threads;\n#endif\n  // folly IOThreadPoolExecutor\n  auto ioPool = std::make_shared&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt;(numMetaIoThreads);\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;apache::thrift::concurrency::ThreadManager&gt; Meta server is required\";\n  clientsMan_ = std::make_shared&lt;thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;cpp2::MetaServiceAsyncClient&gt;&gt;(\n      FLAGS_enable_ssl || FLAGS_enable_meta_ssl);\n  updateActive();\n  updateLeader();\n  bgThread_ = std::make_unique&lt;thread::GenericWorker&gt;();\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Create meta client to \" &lt;&lt; active_;\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; folly::sformat(\n      \"root path: {}, data path size: {}\", options_.rootPath_, options_.dataPaths_.size());\n}\n\nMetaClient::~MetaClient() {\n  notifyStop();\n  stop();\n  delete metadata_.load();\n  VLOG(3) &lt;&lt; \"~MetaClient\";\n}\n\n#ifdef BUILD_STANDALONE\nStatusOr&lt;bool&gt; MetaClient::checkLocalMachineRegistered() {\n  auto ret = heartbeat().get();\n  if (!ret.ok()) {\n    if (ret.status().toString() == \"Machine not existed!\") {\n      return false;\n    }\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Check register failed: \" &lt;&lt; ret.status();\n    return Status::Error(\"Check register failed!\");\n  }\n  return true;\n}\n#endif\n\nbool MetaClient::isMetadReady()",

        "contents": "  return true;\n}\n#endif\n\nbool MetaClient::isMetadReady() {\n  // UNKNOWN is reserved for tools such as upgrader, in that case the ip/port is not set. We do\n  // not send heartbeat to meta to avoid writing error host info (e.g. Host(\"\", 0))\n  if (options_.role_ != cpp2::HostRole::UNKNOWN) {\n    auto ret = heartbeat().get();\n    if (!ret.ok()) {\n      LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Heartbeat failed, status:\" &lt;&lt; ret.status();\n      return ready_;\n    } else if (options_.role_ == cpp2::HostRole::STORAGE &amp;&amp;\n               metaServerVersion_ != EXPECT_META_VERSION) {\n      LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Expect meta version is \" &lt;&lt; EXPECT_META_VERSION &lt;&lt; \", but actual is \"\n                 &lt;&lt; metaServerVersion_;\n      return ready_;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ready_ will be set in loadData\n  loadData();\n  loadCfg();\n  return ready_;\n}\n\nbool MetaClient::waitForMetadReady(int count, int retryIntervalSecs) {\n  if (!options_.skipConfig_) {\n    std::string gflagsJsonPath;\n    GflagsManager::getGflagsModule(gflagsModule_);\n    gflagsDeclared_ = GflagsManager::declareGflags(gflagsModule_);\n  }\n  isRunning_ = true;\n  int tryCount = count;\n  while (!isMetadReady() &amp;&amp; ((count == -1) || (tryCount &gt; 0)) &amp;&amp; isRunning_) {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Waiting for the metad to be ready!\";\n    --tryCount;\n    ::sleep(retryIntervalSecs);\n  }  // end while\n\n  if (!isRunning_) {\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Connect to the MetaServer Failed\";\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Verify the graph server version\n  auto status = verifyVersion();\n  if (!status.ok()) {\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; status;\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Save graph version to meta\n  status = saveVersionToMeta();\n  if (!status.ok()) {\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; status;\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  CHECK(bgThread_-&gt;start());\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Register time task for heartbeat!\";\n  size_t delayMS = FLAGS_heartbeat_interval_secs * 1000 + folly::Random::rand32(900);\n  bgThread_-&gt;addDelayTask(delayMS, &amp;MetaClient::heartBeatThreadFunc, this);\n  return ready_;\n}\n\nvoid MetaClient::notifyStop() {\n  if (bgThread_ != nullptr)",

        "contents": "########## basics ##########\n# Whether to run as a daemon process\n--daemonize=true\n# The file to host the process id\n--pid_file=pids/nebula-metad.pid\n\n########## logging ##########\n# The directory to host logging files\n--log_dir=logs\n# Log level, 0, 1, 2, 3 for INFO, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL respectively\n--minloglevel=0\n# Verbose log level, 1, 2, 3, 4, the higher of the level, the more verbose of the logging\n--v=0\n# Maximum seconds to buffer the log messages\n--logbufsecs=0\n# Whether to redirect stdout and stderr to separate output files\n--redirect_stdout=true\n# Destination filename of stdout and stderr, which will also reside in log_dir.\n--stdout_log_file=metad-stdout.log\n--stderr_log_file=metad-stderr.log\n# Copy log messages at or above this level to stderr in addition to logfiles. The numbers of severity levels INFO, WARNING, ERROR, and FATAL are 0, 1, 2, and 3, respectively.\n--stderrthreshold=3\n# wether logging files' name contain time stamp, If Using logrotate to rotate logging files, than should set it to true.\n--timestamp_in_logfile_name=true\n\n########## networking ##########\n# Comma separated Meta Server addresses\n--meta_server_addrs=127.0.0.1:9559\n# Local IP used to identify the nebula-metad process.\n# Change it to an address other than loopback if the service is distributed or\n# will be accessed remotely.\n--local_ip=127.0.0.1\n# Meta daemon listening port\n--port=9559\n# HTTP service ip\n--ws_ip=0.0.0.0\n# HTTP service port\n--ws_http_port=19559\n# Port to listen on Storage with HTTP protocol, it corresponds to ws_http_port in storage's configuration file\n--ws_storage_http_port=19779\n\n########## storage ##########\n# Root data path, here should be only single path for metad\n--data_path=data/meta\n\n########## Misc #########\n# The default number of parts when a space is created\n--default_parts_num=100\n# The default replica factor when a space is created\n--default_replica_factor=1\n\n--heartbeat_interval_secs=10\n--agent_heartbeat_interval_secs=60",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "########## basics ##########\n# Whether to run as a daemon process\n--daemonize=true\n# The file to host the process id\n--pid_file=pids/nebula-metad.pid\n\n########## logging ##########\n# The directory to host logging files\n--log_dir=logs\n# Log level, 0, 1, 2, 3 for INFO, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL respectively\n--minloglevel=0\n# Verbose log level, 1, 2, 3, 4, the higher of the level, the more verbose of the logging\n--v=0\n# Maximum seconds to buffer the log messages\n--logbufsecs=0\n# Whether to redirect stdout and stderr to separate output files\n--redirect_stdout=true\n# Destination filename of stdout and stderr, which will also reside in log_dir.\n--stdout_log_file=metad-stdout.log\n--stderr_log_file=metad-stderr.log\n# Copy log messages at or above this level to stderr in addition to logfiles. The numbers of severity levels INFO, WARNING, ERROR, and FATAL are 0, 1, 2, and 3, respectively.\n--stderrthreshold=3\n# wether logging files' name contain time stamp, If Using logrotate to rotate logging files, than should set it to true.\n--timestamp_in_logfile_name=true\n\n########## networking ##########\n# Comma separated Meta Server addresses\n--meta_server_addrs=127.0.0.1:9559\n# Local IP used to identify the nebula-metad process.\n# Change it to an address other than loopback if the service is distributed or\n# will be accessed remotely.\n--local_ip=127.0.0.1\n# Meta daemon listening port\n--port=9559\n# HTTP service ip\n--ws_ip=0.0.0.0\n# HTTP service port\n--ws_http_port=19559\n# Port to listen on Storage with HTTP protocol, it corresponds to ws_http_port in storage's configuration file\n--ws_storage_http_port=19779\n\n########## storage ##########\n# Root data path, here should be only single path for metad\n--data_path=data/meta\n\n########## Misc #########\n# The default number of parts when a space is created\n--default_parts_num=100\n# The default replica factor when a space is created\n--default_replica_factor=1\n\n--heartbeat_interval_secs=10\n--agent_heartbeat_interval_secs=60",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "########## basics ##########\n# Whether to run as a daemon process\n--daemonize=true\n# The file to host the process id\n--pid_file=pids/nebula-metad.pid\n\n########## logging ##########\n# The directory to host logging files\n--log_dir=logs\n# Log level, 0, 1, 2, 3 for INFO, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL respectively\n--minloglevel=0\n# Verbose log level, 1, 2, 3, 4, the higher of the level, the more verbose of the logging\n--v=0\n# Maximum seconds to buffer the log messages\n--logbufsecs=0\n# Whether to redirect stdout and stderr to separate output files\n--redirect_stdout=true\n# Destination filename of stdout and stderr, which will also reside in log_dir.\n--stdout_log_file=metad-stdout.log\n--stderr_log_file=metad-stderr.log\n# Copy log messages at or above this level to stderr in addition to logfiles. The numbers of severity levels INFO, WARNING, ERROR, and FATAL are 0, 1, 2, and 3, respectively.\n--stderrthreshold=3\n# wether logging files' name contain time stamp, If Using logrotate to rotate logging files, than should set it to true.\n--timestamp_in_logfile_name=true\n\n########## networking ##########\n# Comma separated Meta Server addresses\n--meta_server_addrs=127.0.0.1:9559\n# Local IP used to identify the nebula-metad process.\n# Change it to an address other than loopback if the service is distributed or\n# will be accessed remotely.\n--local_ip=127.0.0.1\n# Meta daemon listening port\n--port=9559\n# HTTP service ip\n--ws_ip=0.0.0.0\n# HTTP service port\n--ws_http_port=19559\n# Port to listen on Storage with HTTP protocol, it corresponds to ws_http_port in storage's configuration file\n--ws_storage_http_port=19779\n\n########## storage ##########\n# Root data path, here should be only single path for metad\n--data_path=data/meta\n\n########## Misc #########\n# The default number of parts when a space is created\n--default_parts_num=100\n# The default replica factor when a space is created\n--default_replica_factor=1\n\n--heartbeat_interval_secs=10\n--agent_heartbeat_interval_secs=60",

        "contents": "t4: 后台线程应用 log[10]\n    lastApplied = 10\n    \nt5: 此时 commitIndex == lastApplied == 10\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 什么时候会有差距？\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. 正常情况: 应用日志需要时间（状态机操作可能慢）\n   commitIndex 先更新，lastApplied 追赶\n\n2. 重启后: commitIndex 可以从 Leader 那里快速获取\n          lastApplied 需要重新回放日志（或从快照恢复）\n\n3. 高负载: 日志提交很快，但应用跟不上\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**结论**：正常稳定运行时它们基本相等，但设计上允许有滞后。\n\n---\n\n## 问题 5：中间日志丢失怎么办？\n\n### 首先：正常情况下不会\"中间丢失\"\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nRaft 日志是连续的，不允许有\"空洞\":\n  log = [1, 2, 3, _, 5, 6]  ← 这种情况不应该存在\n\n原因:\n- 持久化保证落盘后不丢\n- AppendEntries 的一致性检查保证连续性\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 如果真的发生了（硬件故障、磁盘损坏）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n情况: 节点 B 的日志因为磁盘错误丢失了一部分\n\nLeader 发送 AppendEntries:\n  prevLogIndex = 100\n  prevLogTerm = 5\n  entries = [101, 102]\n\nFollower B 检查:\n  log[100] 不存在或 term 不匹配\n  → 返回 success = false\n\nLeader 处理:\n  nextIndex[B]--  → 重试 prevLogIndex = 99\n  继续递减，直到找到匹配点\n  或者 nextIndex 小于 Leader 的日志起点 → 发送 InstallSnapshot\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### InstallSnapshot 兜底\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n极端情况:\n  Leader 日志从 index 1000 开始（之前的都快照了）\n  Follower B 日志损坏，完全丢失\n\n流程:\n1. Leader 不断递减 nextIndex[B]\n2. 发现 nextIndex[B] &lt; 1000（Leader 没有这么旧的日志）\n3. Leader 发送 InstallSnapshot RPC\n4. Follower B 安装快照，重建状态\n5. 继续正常的日志同步\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 总结\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ 日志丢失的恢复机制                          │\n├────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│ 轻度: AppendEntries 回退重传               │",

          {
            "text": "3. 高负载: 日志提交很快，但应用跟不上",
            "lineNumber": 1295
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1296
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1297
          },
          {
            "text": "**结论**：正常稳定运行时它们基本相等，但设计上允许有滞后。",
            "lineNumber": 1298
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1299
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1300
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1301
          },
          {
            "text": "## 问题 5：中间日志丢失怎么办？",
            "lineNumber": 1302
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1303
          },
          {
            "text": "### 首先：正常情况下不会\"中间丢失\"",
            "lineNumber": 1304
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1305
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1306
          },
          {
            "text": "Raft 日志是连续的，不允许有\"空洞\":",
            "lineNumber": 1307
          },
          {
            "text": "  log = [1, 2, 3, _, 5, 6]  ← 这种情况不应该存在",
            "lineNumber": 1308
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1309
          },
          {
            "text": "原因:",
            "lineNumber": 1310
          },
          {
            "text": "- 持久化保证落盘后不丢",
            "lineNumber": 1311
          },
          {
            "text": "- AppendEntries 的一致性检查保证连续性",
            "lineNumber": 1312
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1313
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1314
          },
          {
            "text": "### 如果真的发生了（硬件故障、磁盘损坏）",
            "lineNumber": 1315
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1316
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1317
          },
          {
            "text": "情况: 节点 B 的日志因为磁盘错误丢失了一部分",
            "lineNumber": 1318
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1319
          },
          {
            "text": "Leader 发送 AppendEntries:",
            "lineNumber": 1320
          },
          {
            "text": "  prevLogIndex = 100",
            "lineNumber": 1321
          },
          {
            "text": "  prevLogTerm = 5",
            "lineNumber": 1322
          },
          {
            "text": "  entries = [101, 102]",
            "lineNumber": 1323
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1324
          },
          {
            "text": "Follower B 检查:",
            "lineNumber": 1325
          },
          {
            "text": "  log[100] 不存在或 term 不匹配",
            "lineNumber": 1326
          },
          {
            "text": "  → 返回 success = false",
            "lineNumber": 1327
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1328
          },
          {
            "text": "Leader 处理:",
            "lineNumber": 1329
          },
          {
            "text": "  nextIndex[B]--  → 重试 prevLogIndex = 99",
            "lineNumber": 1330
          },
          {
            "text": "  继续递减，直到找到匹配点",
            "lineNumber": 1331
          },
          {
            "text": "  或者 nextIndex 小于 Leader 的日志起点 → 发送 InstallSnapshot",
            "lineNumber": 1332
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1333
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1334
          },
          {
            "text": "### InstallSnapshot 兜底",
            "lineNumber": 1335
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1336
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1337
          },
          {
            "text": "极端情况:",
            "lineNumber": 1338
          },
          {
            "text": "  Leader 日志从 index 1000 开始（之前的都快照了）",
            "lineNumber": 1339
          },
          {
            "text": "  Follower B 日志损坏，完全丢失",
            "lineNumber": 1340
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1341
          },
          {
            "text": "流程:",
            "lineNumber": 1342
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Leader 不断递减 nextIndex[B]",
            "lineNumber": 1343
          },
          {
            "text": "2. 发现 nextIndex[B] &lt; 1000（Leader 没有这么旧的日志）",
            "lineNumber": 1344
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Leader 发送 InstallSnapshot RPC",
            "lineNumber": 1345
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Follower B 安装快照，重建状态",
            "lineNumber": 1346
          },
          {
            "text": "5. 继续正常的日志同步",
            "lineNumber": 1347
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1348
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1349
          },
          {
            "text": "### 总结",
            "lineNumber": 1350
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1351
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1352
          },
          {
            "text": "┌────────────────────────────────────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 1353
          },
          {
            "text": "│ 日志丢失的恢复机制                          │",
            "lineNumber": 1354
          },
          {
            "text": "├────────────────────────────────────────────┤",
            "lineNumber": 1355
          },
          {
            "text": "│ 轻度: AppendEntries 回退重传               │",
            "lineNumber": 1356
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4630436897277832
    },

        "contents": "void RestoreProcessor::process(const cpp2::RestoreMetaReq&amp; req) {\n  auto files = req.get_files();\n  if (files.empty()) {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"restore must contain the sst file.\";\n    handleErrorCode(nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RESTORE_FAILURE);\n    onFinished();\n    return;\n  }\n\n  auto ret = kvstore_-&gt;restoreFromFiles(kDefaultSpaceId, files);\n  if (ret != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Failed to restore file\";\n    handleErrorCode(nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RESTORE_FAILURE);\n    onFinished();\n    return;\n  }\n\n  auto batch = kvstore_-&gt;startBatchWrite();\n  auto replaceHosts = req.get_hosts();\n  if (!replaceHosts.empty()) {\n    std::map&lt;HostAddr, HostAddr&gt; hostMap;\n    for (auto h : replaceHosts) {\n      if (h.get_from_host() == h.get_to_host()) {\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      hostMap[h.get_from_host()] = h.get_to_host();\n    }\n\n    if (!hostMap.empty()) {\n      auto result = replaceHostInPartition(batch.get(), hostMap);\n      if (result != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n        LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"replaceHost in partition fails when recovered\";\n        handleErrorCode(result);\n        onFinished();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      result = replaceHostInZone(batch.get(), hostMap);\n      if (result != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n        LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"replaceHost in zone fails when recovered\";\n        handleErrorCode(result);\n        onFinished();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      result = replaceHostInMachine(batch.get(), hostMap);\n      if (result != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n        LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"replaceHost in machine fails when recovered\";\n        handleErrorCode(result);\n        onFinished();\n        return;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  for (auto&amp; f : files) {\n    unlink(f.c_str());\n  }\n\n  ret = kvstore_-&gt;batchWriteWithoutReplicator(kDefaultSpaceId, std::move(batch));\n  handleErrorCode(ret);\n  onFinished();\n}\n\n}  // namespace meta\n}  // namespace nebula",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.specstory/history/2026-01-26_07-20Z-nextindex-and-matchindex-difference.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 1529
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 1602
          }
        },
        "contents": "例:\n  leaderCommit = 10\n  Follower 的日志只到 index = 8\n  → Follower 的 commitIndex = min(10, 8) = 8\n  \n  等 Follower 收到 9, 10 的日志后，commitIndex 才能继续增加\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 为什么需要这个？\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nFollower 自己无法知道\"哪些日志已被多数派确认\"\n只有 Leader 知道（Leader 收集所有 Follower 的响应）\n所以 Leader 需要告诉 Follower: \"可以 commit 到这里了\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 问题 5：如果 Leader 本身日志丢失了怎么办？\n\n这个问题要分情况讨论。\n\n### 情况 A：Leader 在位时日志丢失（磁盘故障）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n这是灾难性故障，但 Raft 仍然安全:\n\n1. Leader 丢失部分日志后，可能无法正常工作\n2. Leader 会宕机或变得不正常\n3. 其他节点选举超时，发起新选举\n4. 新 Leader 从多数派中产生（日志\"足够新\"的节点）\n5. 新 Leader 有完整的已提交日志（因为已提交 = 多数派有）\n6. 原 Leader 恢复后变成 Follower，从新 Leader 同步日志\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 情况 B：Leader 丢失未提交的日志\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n这是允许的，因为未提交的日志本来就不保证持久:\n\n例:\n  Leader: [1,2,3,4,5]  5 还没提交，只有 Leader 有\n  Leader 崩溃，日志 5 丢失\n  \n  新 Leader 当选，日志是 [1,2,3,4]\n  → 日志 5 丢失，客户端收到失败响应（或超时）\n  → 这是正确的行为！未提交的数据允许丢失\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 情况 C：Leader 丢失已提交的日志\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n已提交 = 多数派都有 → Leader 丢了，其他节点还有\n\n例:\n  集群: A(Leader), B, C\n  日志 [1,2,3,4,5] 已提交（A, B, C 都有）\n  \n  A 的磁盘坏了，日志丢失\n  A 宕机\n  \n  B 或 C 成为新 Leader（它们有完整日志）\n  A 恢复后从新 Leader 重新同步\n  \n  → 已提交的数据不会丢失\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 关键保证\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  Raft 的安全性保证:                                         │",

        "contents": "      if (code == nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n        std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; g(raftLock_);\n        CHECK_EQ(lastLogId, lastCommitId);\n        committedLogId_ = lastCommitId;\n        committedLogTerm_ = lastCommitTerm;\n        auto nowCostMs = lastMsgSentDur_.elapsedInMSec();\n        auto nowTime = static_cast&lt;uint64_t&gt;(time::WallClock::fastNowInMilliSec());\n        if (nowTime - nowCostMs &gt;= lastMsgAcceptedTime_ - lastMsgAcceptedCostMs_) {\n          lastMsgAcceptedCostMs_ = nowCostMs;\n          lastMsgAcceptedTime_ = nowTime;\n        }\n\n        if (!commitInThisTerm_) {\n          commitInThisTerm_ = true;\n          bgWorkers_-&gt;addTask(\n              [self = shared_from_this(), term = term_] { self-&gt;onLeaderReady(term);         "contents": "      });\n}\n\nvoid RaftPart::processAppendLogResponses(const AppendLogResponses&amp; resps,\n                                         folly::EventBase* eb,\n                                         AppendLogsIterator iter,\n                                         TermID currTerm,\n                                         LogID lastLogId,\n                                         LogID committedId,\n                                         TermID prevLogTerm,\n                                         LogID prevLogId,\n                                         std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;Host&gt;&gt; hosts) {\n  // Make sure majority have succeeded\n  size_t numSucceeded = 0;\n  TermID highestTerm = currTerm;\n  for (auto&amp; res : resps) {\n    if (!hosts[res.first]-&gt;isLearner() &amp;&amp;\n        res.second.get_error_code() == nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n      ++numSucceeded;\n    }\n    highestTerm = std::max(highestTerm, res.second.get_current_term());\n  }\n\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode res = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED;\n  {\n    std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; g(raftLock_);\n    if (highestTerm &gt; term_) {\n      term_ = highestTerm;\n      role_ = Role::FOLLOWER;\n      leader_ = HostAddr(\"\", 0);\n      lastLogId_ = wal_-&gt;lastLogId();\n      lastLogTerm_ = wal_-&gt;lastLogTerm();\n      // It is nature to return E_RAFT_TERM_OUT_OF_DATE or LEADER_CHANGE\n      // here, but this will make caller believe this append failed\n      // however, this log is replicated to followers(written in WAL)\n      // and those followers may become leader (use that WAL)\n      // which means this log may actually commit succeeded.\n      res = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_UNKNOWN_APPEND_LOG;\n    }\n  }\n  if (!checkAppendLogResult(res)) {\n    iter.commit(res);\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (numSucceeded &gt;= quorum_) {\n    // Majority have succeeded",

There are two choices: ask leader to send logs after committedLogId_ or\n      // just do nothing.\n      if (req.get_last_log_id_sent() &lt; committedLogId_ ||\n          wal_-&gt;lastLogId() &lt; req.get_last_log_id_sent()) {\n        // case 1 and case 2\n        resp.last_matched_log_id_ref() = committedLogId_;\n        resp.last_matched_log_term() = committedLogTerm_;\n        resp.error_code() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_LOG_GAP;\n        return;\n      }\n      auto prevLogTerm = wal_-&gt;getLogTerm(req.get_last_log_id_sent());\n      if (UNLIKELY(prevLogTerm == FileBasedWal::INVALID_TERM)) {\n        /*\n        At this point, the condition below established:\n        committedLogId &lt;= req.get_last_log_id_sent() &lt;= wal_-&gt;lastLogId()\n\n        When INVALID_TERM is returned, we failed to find the log of req.get_last_log_id_sent()\n        in wal.         "contents": "├────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│ 轻度: AppendEntries 回退重传               │\n│ 重度: InstallSnapshot 全量恢复             │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\nRaft 的设计保证: 只要多数派正常，数据就不会丢失\n单点故障可以通过 Leader 重新同步恢复\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n_**User**_\n\n1.那follower是在自己返回对appendEntries的确认后才更新commitIndex，还是接收到就更新？\n2.commit就是应用log中添加的指令？\n3.如果某节点漏掉了一条日志，之后又新来了一条就直接追加？那漏掉的那一条怎么办？\n4.“ leaderCommit    Leader 的 commitIndex（告诉 Follower 可以提交到哪）”什么叫告诉Folloer可以提交到哪儿？index吗？\n5.为什么AppendEntries RPC就能保证不会中间丢失了？如果leader本身就丢了一部分呢？\n\n---\n\n_**Agent (model claude-4.5-opus-high-thinking, mode Agent)**_\n\n&lt;think&gt;&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;Thought Process&lt;/summary&gt;\n用户继续问了 5 个关于 Raft 的问题，让我逐一解答：\n\n1. Follower 更新 commitIndex 的时机\n2. commit 和 apply 的区别\n3. 漏掉日志的处理\n4. leaderCommit 的含义\n5. 如果 Leader 本身日志丢失了怎么办\n\n这些问题都很关键，需要仔细解答。&lt;/details&gt;&lt;/think&gt;\n\n---\n\n继续解答这些问题。\n\n---\n\n## 问题 1：Follower 什么时候更新 commitIndex？\n\n**收到 AppendEntries 并处理完日志后，根据 leaderCommit 更新。**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nFollower 处理 AppendEntries 的流程:\n\n1. 检查 term\n2. 检查 prevLogIndex/prevLogTerm（一致性检查）\n3. 处理冲突，追加新日志\n4. 更新 commitIndex:  ← 在返回响应之前\n   if leaderCommit &gt; commitIndex:\n       commitIndex = min(leaderCommit, 最后一条新日志的 index)\n5. 返回 success = true\n\n所以是: 处理完日志 → 更新 commitIndex → 返回响应\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**注意**：不是\"收到就更新\"，而是**日志追加成功后**才更新。因为 commitIndex 不能超过自己实际拥有的日志。",

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 1533
          }
        },
        "contents": "commit: 保证\"持久性\"（数据不丢）\napply:  实现\"可见性\"（对外生效）\n\n分开的好处:\n- apply 可能很慢（执行复杂操作）\n- commit 可以快速响应客户端\"数据已安全\"\n- 两者解耦，互不阻塞\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 问题 3：漏掉一条日志后新来的会直接追加吗？\n\n**不会直接追加。这正是 prevLogIndex/prevLogTerm 检查的作用。**\n\n### 场景\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nLeader:   [1] [2] [3] [4] [5]\n                      ↑ 要发送\n\nFollower: [1] [2] [_] [4]    ← 假设 index=3 丢失了（不可能，但假设）\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### AppendEntries 处理\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nLeader 发送:\n  prevLogIndex = 4\n  prevLogTerm = ?\n  entries = [5]\n\nFollower 检查:\n  log[4] 存在吗？存在\n  log[4].term == prevLogTerm？\n\n情况 A: term 匹配 → 追加 [5]（但这种情况说明 [3] 其实没丢）\n\n情况 B: term 不匹配 → 拒绝，返回 success = false\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 关键：Raft 保证不会有\"空洞\"\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n实际上\"中间丢失\"这种情况不会发生:\n\n1. 日志是顺序追加的\n   - 只能在末尾追加，不能跳跃\n\n2. 一致性检查保证连续性\n   - 要追加 index=5，必须先确认 index=4 存在且匹配\n   - 要追加 index=4，必须先确认 index=3 存在且匹配\n   - ... 归纳下去，整条链都是连续的\n\n3. Leader 处理不匹配\n   - 如果 Follower 拒绝，Leader 会回退 nextIndex\n   - 从更早的位置开始重传，填补\"缺失\"的部分\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 问题 4：leaderCommit 告诉 Follower 什么？\n\n**是的，就是一个 index 值。**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nleaderCommit = Leader 的 commitIndex\n             = Leader 知道的\"已被多数派确认的最高日志索引\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Follower 怎么用？\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nFollower 收到 leaderCommit 后:\n\nif leaderCommit &gt; 自己的 commitIndex:\n    commitIndex = min(leaderCommit, 自己最后一条日志的 index)\n                       ↑                    ↑\n                  Leader 说的          不能超过自己有的\n\n例:\n  leaderCommit = 10\n  Follower 的日志只到 index = 8",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "commit: 保证\"持久性\"（数据不丢）",

          },
          {
            "text": "情况 B: term 不匹配 → 拒绝，返回 success = false",
            "lineNumber": 1489
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1490
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1491
          },
          {
            "text": "### 关键：Raft 保证不会有\"空洞\"",
            "lineNumber": 1492
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1493
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1494
          },
          {
            "text": "实际上\"中间丢失\"这种情况不会发生:",
            "lineNumber": 1495
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1496
          },
          {
            "text": "1. 日志是顺序追加的",
            "lineNumber": 1497
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 只能在末尾追加，不能跳跃",
            "lineNumber": 1498
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1499
          },
          {
            "text": "2. 一致性检查保证连续性",
            "lineNumber": 1500
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 要追加 index=5，必须先确认 index=4 存在且匹配",
            "lineNumber": 1501
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 要追加 index=4，必须先确认 index=3 存在且匹配",
            "lineNumber": 1502
          },
          {
            "text": "   - ... 归纳下去，整条链都是连续的",
            "lineNumber": 1503
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1504
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Leader 处理不匹配",
            "lineNumber": 1505
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 如果 Follower 拒绝，Leader 会回退 nextIndex",
            "lineNumber": 1506
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 从更早的位置开始重传，填补\"缺失\"的部分",
            "lineNumber": 1507
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1508
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1509
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1510
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1511
          },
          {
            "text": "## 问题 4：leaderCommit 告诉 Follower 什么？",
            "lineNumber": 1512
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1513
          },
          {
            "text": "**是的，就是一个 index 值。**",
            "lineNumber": 1514
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1515
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1516
          },
          {
            "text": "leaderCommit = Leader 的 commitIndex",
            "lineNumber": 1517
          },
          {
            "text": "             = Leader 知道的\"已被多数派确认的最高日志索引\"",
            "lineNumber": 1518
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1519
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1520
          },
          {
            "text": "### Follower 怎么用？",
            "lineNumber": 1521
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1522
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1523
          },
          {
            "text": "Follower 收到 leaderCommit 后:",
            "lineNumber": 1524
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1525
          },
          {
            "text": "if leaderCommit &gt; 自己的 commitIndex:",
            "lineNumber": 1526
          },
          {
            "text": "    commitIndex = min(leaderCommit, 自己最后一条日志的 index)",
            "lineNumber": 1527
          },
          {
            "text": "                       ↑                    ↑",
            "lineNumber": 1528
          },
          {
            "text": "                  Leader 说的          不能超过自己有的",
            "lineNumber": 1529
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1530
          },
          {
            "text": "例:",
            "lineNumber": 1531
          },
          {
            "text": "  leaderCommit = 10",
            "lineNumber": 1532
          },
          {
            "text": "  Follower 的日志只到 index = 8",
            "lineNumber": 1533
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3943454921245575
    },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.specstory/history/2026-01-26_07-20Z-nextindex-and-matchindex-difference.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 42
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 94
          }
        },
        "contents": "这两个配合使用：\n\n\nLeader 根据 &#96;nextIndex[i]&#96; 决定向每个 follower 发送哪些日志条目。当 AppendEntries 成功时，同时更新 &#96;matchIndex[i]&#96; 和 &#96;nextIndex[i]&#96;；失败时则只递减 &#96;nextIndex[i]&#96; 后重试。最后，leader 通过扫描 &#96;matchIndex[]&#96; 数组找出大多数节点已复制的最高日志索引，以此来推进 commitIndex。&lt;/details&gt;&lt;/think&gt;\n\n---\n\n这是 Raft 共识算法中 leader 维护的两个关键状态，它们的区别如下：\n\n## &#96;nextIndex[]&#96; vs &#96;matchIndex[]&#96;\n\n### &#96;nextIndex[]&#96; — 乐观的猜测\n\n- **含义**：Leader 认为应该发送给该 follower 的**下一条**日志条目的索引\n- **初始化**：leader 最后日志索引 + 1（乐观假设 follower 与 leader 完全同步）\n- **特点**：\n  - 是一个**乐观估计**，可能会猜错\n  - **可以递减**：如果 AppendEntries RPC 因日志不一致而失败，leader 会递减 &#96;nextIndex&#96; 并重试\n  - 用于决定\"发送什么\"\n\n### &#96;matchIndex[]&#96; — 保守的确认\n\n- **含义**：Leader **确认**已经复制到该 follower 上的最高日志条目索引\n- **初始化**：0（保守假设，什么都没复制）\n- **特点**：\n  - 是一个**保守确认**，只有收到成功响应才更新\n  - **只增不减**（单调递增）\n  - 用于计算 **commitIndex**（当大多数节点的 &#96;matchIndex&#96; 都 &gt;= N 时，可以提交索引 N 的日志）\n\n## 工作流程示意\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nLeader 当选后:\n  nextIndex[follower]  = lastLogIndex + 1  (乐观: 假设你已经全有了)\n  matchIndex[follower] = 0                  (保守: 我还没确认你有什么)\n\n发送 AppendEntries 给 follower:\n  ├── 成功 → matchIndex[i] = nextIndex[i] - 1\n  │         nextIndex[i]++\n  │\n  └── 失败(日志不一致) → nextIndex[i]--  (回退重试)\n                         matchIndex 不变\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 为什么需要两个？\n\n| 场景 | nextIndex | matchIndex |\n|------|-----------|------------|\n| 目的 | 决定发送哪些日志 | 决定哪些日志可以提交 |\n| 性质 | 可回退的探测指针 | 只增的确认指针 |\n| 安全性 | 猜错了没关系，重试即可 | 必须准确，关系到数据一致性 |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "这两个配合使用：",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {

        "contents": "bool RaftPart::checkAppendLogResult(nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode res) {\n  if (res != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n    {\n      std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; lck(logsLock_);\n      auto setPromiseForLogs = [&amp;](LogCache&amp; logs) {\n        for (auto&amp; log : logs) {\n          auto&amp; promiseRef = std::get&lt;4&gt;(log);\n          if (!promiseRef.isFulfilled()) {\n            promiseRef.setValue(res);\n          }\n        }\n      };\n      setPromiseForLogs(logs_);\n      setPromiseForLogs(sendingLogs_);\n      logs_.clear();\n      sendingLogs_.clear();\n      bufferOverFlow_ = false;\n      replicatingLogs_ = false;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n  return true;\n}\n\nvoid RaftPart::reset() {\n  CHECK(!raftLock_.try_lock());\n  wal_-&gt;reset();\n  cleanup();\n  lastLogId_ = committedLogId_ = 0;\n  lastLogTerm_ = committedLogTerm_ = 0;\n}\n\nnebula::cpp2::ErrorCode RaftPart::isCaughtUp(const HostAddr&amp; peer) {\n  std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; lck(raftLock_);\n  VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Check whether I catch up\";\n  if (role_ != Role::LEADER) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"I am not the leader\";\n    return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_LEADER_CHANGED;\n  }\n  if (peer == addr_) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"I am the leader\";\n    return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED;\n  }\n  for (auto&amp; host : hosts_) {\n    if (host-&gt;addr_ == peer) {\n      if (host-&gt;followerCommittedLogId_ == 0 ||\n          host-&gt;followerCommittedLogId_ &lt; wal_-&gt;firstLogId()) {\n        VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"The committed log id of peer is \" &lt;&lt; host-&gt;followerCommittedLogId_\n                &lt;&lt; \", which is invalid or less than my first wal log id\";\n        return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_SENDING_SNAPSHOT;\n      }\n      return host-&gt;sendingSnapshot_ ? nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_SENDING_SNAPSHOT\n                                    : nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED;\n    }\n  }\n  return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_INVALID_PEER;\n}\n\nbool RaftPart::linkCurrentWAL(const char* newPath)",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.specstory/history/2026-01-26_07-20Z-nextindex-and-matchindex-difference.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 427
          }
        },
        "contents": "很好的问题！这涉及到 Snapshot 与日志同步的衔接问题。\n\n## 为什么需要？\n\n创建 Snapshot 后，被快照覆盖的旧日志会被**删除**以节省空间：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n创建快照前:\n  日志: [1,t1] [2,t1] [3,t2] [4,t2] [5,t3] [6,t3] [7,t3]\n                              ↑\n                        快照截止点 (index=5)\n\n创建快照后:\n  快照: {state_machine_data, lastIncludedIndex=5, lastIncludedTerm=t3}\n  日志: [6,t3] [7,t3]   ← 日志 1-5 被删除了！\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**问题来了**：如果 Leader 要发送日志 6，需要检查 prevLogIndex=5，但日志 5 已经被删了！\n\n## 如何解决？\n\n用快照的元数据替代被删除的日志信息：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nAppendEntries RPC (发送日志 6):\n├── prevLogIndex = 5\n├── prevLogTerm = t3    ← 从哪里获取？\n└── entries = [6,t3]\n\nFollower 收到后检查:\n  if (prevLogIndex == snapshot.lastIncludedIndex) {\n      // 用快照元数据验证\n      return prevLogTerm == snapshot.lastIncludedTerm;\n  } else if (prevLogIndex &lt; snapshot.lastIncludedIndex) {\n      // 已经被快照包含，肯定一致\n      return true;\n  } else {\n      // 在现有日志中查找\n      return log[prevLogIndex].term == prevLogTerm;\n  }\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 两个典型场景\n\n### 场景 1：正常追加日志\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nLeader:   Snapshot(1-5) + [6,t3] [7,t3] [8,t3]\n                                         ↑ 要发送\n\nFollower: Snapshot(1-5) + [6,t3] [7,t3]\n\n发送 AppendEntries:\n  prevLogIndex = 7\n  prevLogTerm = t3 (从 Follower 自己的日志中查)\n  entries = [8,t3]\n\nFollower 检查 log[7].term == t3 ✓ 接受\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 场景 2：快照边界处追加\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nLeader:   Snapshot(1-5) + [6,t3]\n                          ↑ 要发送\n\nFollower: Snapshot(1-5)   ← 只有快照，没有日志 6\n\n发送 AppendEntries:\n  prevLogIndex = 5\n  prevLogTerm = t3\n  entries = [6,t3]\n\nFollower 检查:\n  日志 5 不存在（被快照了）",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "很好的问题！这涉及到 Snapshot 与日志同步的衔接问题。",
            "lineNumber": 353
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 354
          },
          {
            "text": "## 为什么需要？",
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 356
          },
          {
            "text": "创建 Snapshot 后，被快照覆盖的旧日志会被**删除**以节省空间：",
            "lineNumber": 357
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 358
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 359
          },
          {
            "text": "创建快照前:",
            "lineNumber": 360
          },
          {
            "text": "  日志: [1,t1] [2,t1] [3,t2] [4,t2] [5,t3] [6,t3] [7,t3]",
            "lineNumber": 361
          },
          {
            "text": "                              ↑",
            "lineNumber": 362
          },
          {
            "text": "                        快照截止点 (index=5)",
            "lineNumber": 363
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 364
          },
          {
            "text": "创建快照后:",
            "lineNumber": 365
          },
          {
            "text": "  快照: {state_machine_data, lastIncludedIndex=5, lastIncludedTerm=t3}",
            "lineNumber": 366
          },
          {
            "text": "  日志: [6,t3] [7,t3]   ← 日志 1-5 被删除了！",
            "lineNumber": 367
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 368
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 369
          },
          {
            "text": "**问题来了**：如果 Leader 要发送日志 6，需要检查 prevLogIndex=5，但日志 5 已经被删了！",
            "lineNumber": 370
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 371
          },
          {
            "text": "## 如何解决？",
            "lineNumber": 372
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 373
          },
          {
            "text": "用快照的元数据替代被删除的日志信息：",
            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 375
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 376
          },
          {
            "text": "AppendEntries RPC (发送日志 6):",
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "text": "├── prevLogIndex = 5",
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "├── prevLogTerm = t3    ← 从哪里获取？",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "text": "└── entries = [6,t3]",
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "Follower 收到后检查:",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "  if (prevLogIndex == snapshot.lastIncludedIndex) {",
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "text": "      // 用快照元数据验证",
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "      return prevLogTerm == snapshot.lastIncludedTerm;",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "text": "  } else if (prevLogIndex &lt; snapshot.lastIncludedIndex) {",
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "      // 已经被快照包含，肯定一致",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "text": "      return true;",
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "  } else {",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "text": "      // 在现有日志中查找",
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "      return log[prevLogIndex].term == prevLogTerm;",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {
            "text": "## 两个典型场景",
            "lineNumber": 395
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 396
          },
          {
            "text": "### 场景 1：正常追加日志",
            "lineNumber": 397
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 398
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "text": "Leader:   Snapshot(1-5) + [6,t3] [7,t3] [8,t3]",
            "lineNumber": 400
          },
          {
            "text": "                                         ↑ 要发送",
            "lineNumber": 401
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 402
          },
          {
            "text": "Follower: Snapshot(1-5) + [6,t3] [7,t3]",
            "lineNumber": 403
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 404
          },
          {
            "text": "发送 AppendEntries:",
            "lineNumber": 405
          },
          {
            "text": "  prevLogIndex = 7",
            "lineNumber": 406
          },
          {
            "text": "  prevLogTerm = t3 (从 Follower 自己的日志中查)",
            "lineNumber": 407
          },
          {
            "text": "  entries = [8,t3]",
            "lineNumber": 408
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 409
          },
          {
            "text": "Follower 检查 log[7].term == t3 ✓ 接受",
            "lineNumber": 410
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 411
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 412
          },
          {
            "text": "### 场景 2：快照边界处追加",
            "lineNumber": 413
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 414
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 415
          },
          {
            "text": "Leader:   Snapshot(1-5) + [6,t3]",
            "lineNumber": 416
          },
          {
            "text": "                          ↑ 要发送",
            "lineNumber": 417
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 418
          },
          {
            "text": "Follower: Snapshot(1-5)   ← 只有快照，没有日志 6",
            "lineNumber": 419
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 420
          },
          {
            "text": "发送 AppendEntries:",
            "lineNumber": 421
          },
          {
            "text": "  prevLogIndex = 5",
            "lineNumber": 422
          },
          {
            "text": "  prevLogTerm = t3",
            "lineNumber": 423
          },
          {
            "text": "  entries = [6,t3]",
            "lineNumber": 424
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 425
          },
          {
            "text": "Follower 检查:",
            "lineNumber": 426
          },
          {
            "text": "  日志 5 不存在（被快照了）",
            "lineNumber": 427
          }
        ]
      },
