        "contents": "        break;\n      }\n      case OP_BATCH_WRITE: {\n        auto batchData = decodeBatchValue(log);\n        for (auto&amp; op : batchData) {\n          // OP_BATCH_REMOVE and OP_BATCH_REMOVE_RANGE is ignored\n          switch (op.first) {\n            case BatchLogType::OP_BATCH_PUT: {\n              batch.put(op.second.first.toString(), op.second.second.toString());\n              break;\n            }\n            case BatchLogType::OP_BATCH_REMOVE: {\n              batch.remove(op.second.first.toString());\n              break;\n            }\n            case BatchLogType::OP_BATCH_REMOVE_RANGE: {\n              batch.rangeRemove(op.second.first.toString(), op.second.second.toString());\n              break;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n      case OP_TRANS_LEADER:\n      case OP_ADD_LEARNER:\n      case OP_ADD_PEER:\n      case OP_REMOVE_PEER: {\n        break;\n      }\n      default: {\n        VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Unknown operation: \" &lt;&lt; static_cast&lt;int32_t&gt;(log[0]);\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (static_cast&lt;int32_t&gt;(batch.size()) &gt; FLAGS_listener_commit_batch_size) {\n      break;\n    }\n    ++(*iter);\n  }\n\n  // apply to state machine\n  if (lastApplyId != -1 &amp;&amp; apply(batch)) {\n    std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; guard(raftLock_);\n    lastApplyLogId_ = lastApplyId;\n    persist(committedLogId_, term_, lastApplyLogId_);\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Listener succeeded apply log to \" &lt;&lt; lastApplyLogId_;\n  }\n}\n\nstd::tuple&lt;nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode, int64_t, int64_t&gt;",

        "contents": "std::shared_ptr&lt;Part&gt; NebulaStore::newPart(GraphSpaceID spaceId,\n                                           PartitionID partId,\n                                           KVEngine* engine,\n                                           bool asLearner,\n                                           const std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt;&amp; raftPeers) {\n  auto walPath = folly::stringPrintf(\"%s/wal/%d\", engine-&gt;getWalRoot(), partId);\n  auto part = std::make_shared&lt;Part&gt;(spaceId,\n                                     partId,\n                                     raftAddr_,\n                                     walPath,\n                                     engine,\n                                     ioPool_,\n                                     bgWorkers_,\n                                     workers_,\n                                     snapshot_,\n                                     clientMan_,\n                                     diskMan_,\n                                     getSpaceVidLen(spaceId));\n  std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt; peersWithoutMe;\n  for (auto&amp; p : raftPeers) {\n    if (p != raftAddr_) {\n      peersWithoutMe.push_back(p);\n    }\n  }\n\n  raftService_-&gt;addPartition(part);\n  for (auto&amp; func : onNewPartAdded_) {\n    func.second(part);\n  }\n  part-&gt;start(std::move(peersWithoutMe), asLearner);\n  diskMan_-&gt;addPartToPath(spaceId, partId, engine-&gt;getDataRoot());\n  return part;\n}\n\nvoid NebulaStore::removeSpace(GraphSpaceID spaceId)",

        "contents": "const char* RaftPart::roleStr(Role role) const {\n  switch (role) {\n    case Role::LEADER:\n      return \"Leader\";\n    case Role::FOLLOWER:\n      return \"Follower\";\n    case Role::CANDIDATE:\n      return \"Candidate\";\n    case Role::LEARNER:\n      return \"Learner\";\n    default:\n      LOG(FATAL) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Invalid role\";\n  }\n  return nullptr;\n}\n\nvoid RaftPart::start(std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt;&amp;&amp; peers, bool asLearner) {\n  std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; g(raftLock_);\n\n  // There are some rare cases that the part start as learner, but wal is not empty. For example,\n  // the node is dead, and one partition is removed from raft group (majority still alive). However,\n  // the part is added back to raft group again as learner. So the wal may be not empty, what is\n  // worse, there could be case that commitLogId is 0, but wal's lastLogId is not 0, which is\n  // obviously not expected\n  if (asLearner) {\n    wal_-&gt;reset();\n  }\n\n  lastLogId_ = wal_-&gt;lastLogId();\n  lastLogTerm_ = wal_-&gt;lastLogTerm();\n  term_ = lastLogTerm_;\n\n  // Set the quorum number\n  quorum_ = (peers.size() + 1) / 2;\n\n  auto logIdAndTerm = lastCommittedLogId();\n  committedLogId_ = logIdAndTerm.first;\n  committedLogTerm_ = logIdAndTerm.second;\n\n  if (lastLogId_ &lt; committedLogId_) {\n    VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Reset lastLogId \" &lt;&lt; lastLogId_ &lt;&lt; \" to be the committedLogId \"\n            &lt;&lt; committedLogId_;\n    lastLogId_ = committedLogId_;\n    lastLogTerm_ = committedLogTerm_;\n    wal_-&gt;reset();\n  }\n  VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"There are \" &lt;&lt; peers.size() &lt;&lt; \" peer hosts, and total \" &lt;&lt; peers.size() + 1\n          &lt;&lt; \" copies. The quorum is \" &lt;&lt; quorum_ + 1 &lt;&lt; \", as learner \" &lt;&lt; asLearner\n          &lt;&lt; \", lastLogId \" &lt;&lt; lastLogId_ &lt;&lt; \", lastLogTerm \" &lt;&lt; lastLogTerm_ &lt;&lt; \", committedLogId \"\n          &lt;&lt; committedLogId_ &lt;&lt; \", committedLogTerm \" &lt;&lt; committedLogTerm_ &lt;&lt; \", term \" &lt;&lt; term_;\n\n  // Start all peer hosts\n  for (auto&amp; addr : peers) {\n    VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Add peer \" &lt;&lt; addr;",

        "contents": "  if (status_ != Status::WAITING_SNAPSHOT) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Begin to receive the snapshot\";\n    // Check leadership\n    nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode err = verifyLeader&lt;cpp2::SendSnapshotRequest&gt;(req);\n    // Set term_ again because it may be modified in verifyLeader\n    resp.current_term_ref() = term_;\n    if (err != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n      // Wrong leadership\n      VLOG(3) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Will not follow the leader\";\n      resp.error_code_ref() = err;\n      return;\n    }\n    reset();\n    status_ = Status::WAITING_SNAPSHOT;\n    lastSnapshotCommitId_ = req.get_committed_log_id();\n    lastSnapshotCommitTerm_ = req.get_committed_log_term();\n    lastTotalCount_ = 0;\n    lastTotalSize_ = 0;\n  } else if (lastSnapshotCommitId_ != req.get_committed_log_id() ||\n             lastSnapshotCommitTerm_ != req.get_committed_log_term()) {\n    // Still waiting for snapshot from another peer, just return error. If the peer doesn't\n    // send any logs during raft_snapshot_timeout, will convert to Status::RUNNING, so we can accept\n    // snapshot again\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_WAITING_SNAPSHOT;\n    return;\n  }\n  if (term_ &gt; req.get_current_term()) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"leader changed, new term \" &lt;&lt; term_\n            &lt;&lt; \" but continue to receive snapshot from old leader \" &lt;&lt; req.get_leader_addr()\n            &lt;&lt; \" of term \" &lt;&lt; req.get_current_term();\n  }\n  lastSnapshotRecvDur_.reset();\n  // TODO(heng): Maybe we should save them into one sst firstly?\n  auto ret = commitSnapshot(\n      req.get_rows(), req.get_committed_log_id(), req.get_committed_log_term(), req.get_done());\n  if (std::get&lt;0&gt;(ret) != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Persist snapshot failed\";\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_PERSIST_SNAPSHOT_FAILED;\n    return;\n  }\n  lastTotalCount_ += std::get&lt;1&gt;(ret);\n  lastTotalSize_ += std::get&lt;2&gt;(ret);\n  if (lastTotalCount_ != req.get_total_count() || lastTotalSize_ != req.get_total_size()) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Bad snapshot, total rows received \" &lt;&lt; lastTotalCount_",

        "contents": "void RaftPart::statusPolling(int64_t startTime) {\n  {\n    std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; g(raftLock_);\n    // If startTime is not same as the time when &#96;statusPolling&#96; is add to event\n    // loop, it means the part has been restarted (it only happens in ut for\n    // now), so don't add another &#96;statusPolling&#96;.\n    if (startTime != startTimeMs_) {\n      return;\n    }\n  }\n  size_t delay = FLAGS_raft_heartbeat_interval_secs * 1000 / 3 + folly::Random::rand32(500);\n  if (needToStartElection()) {\n    if (leaderElection(true).get() &amp;&amp; leaderElection(false).get()) {\n      // elected as leader\n    } else {\n      // No leader has been elected, need to continue\n      // (After sleeping a random period between [500ms, 2s])\n      VLOG(4) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Wait for a while and continue the leader election\";\n      delay = (folly::Random::rand32(1500) + 500);\n    }\n  } else if (needToSendHeartbeat()) {\n    VLOG(4) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Need to send heartbeat\";\n    sendHeartbeat();\n  }\n  if (needToCleanupSnapshot()) {\n    cleanupSnapshot();\n  }\n  {\n    std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; g(raftLock_);\n    if (status_ == Status::RUNNING || status_ == Status::WAITING_SNAPSHOT) {\n      VLOG(4) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Schedule new task\";\n      bgWorkers_-&gt;addDelayTask(\n          delay, [self = shared_from_this(), startTime] { self-&gt;statusPolling(startTime); });\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nbool RaftPart::needToCleanupSnapshot() {\n  std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt;         "contents": "std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftPart&gt; RaftexService::findPart(GraphSpaceID spaceId, PartitionID partId) {\n  folly::RWSpinLock::ReadHolder rh(partsLock_);\n  auto it = parts_.find(std::make_pair(spaceId, partId));\n  if (it == parts_.end()) {\n    // Part not found\n    VLOG(4) &lt;&lt; \"Cannot find the part \" &lt;&lt; partId &lt;&lt; \" in the graph space \" &lt;&lt; spaceId;\n    return std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftPart&gt;();\n  }\n\n  // Otherwise, return the part pointer\n  return it-&gt;second;\n}\n\nvoid RaftexService::getState(cpp2::GetStateResponse&amp; resp, const cpp2::GetStateRequest&amp; req) {\n  auto part = findPart(req.get_space(), req.get_part());\n  if (part != nullptr) {\n    part-&gt;getState(resp);\n  } else {\n    resp.term_ref() = -1;\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_UNKNOWN_PART;\n  }\n}\n\nvoid RaftexService::askForVote(cpp2::AskForVoteResponse&amp; resp, const cpp2::AskForVoteRequest&amp; req) {\n  auto part = findPart(req.get_space(), req.get_part());\n  if (!part) {\n    // Not found\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_UNKNOWN_PART;\n    return;\n  }\n\n  part-&gt;processAskForVoteRequest(req, resp);\n}\n\nvoid RaftexService::appendLog(cpp2::AppendLogResponse&amp; resp, const cpp2::AppendLogRequest&amp; req) {\n  auto part = findPart(req.get_space(), req.get_part());\n  if (!part) {\n    // Not found\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_UNKNOWN_PART;\n    return;\n  }\n\n  part-&gt;processAppendLogRequest(req, resp);\n}\n\nvoid RaftexService::sendSnapshot(cpp2::SendSnapshotResponse&amp; resp,\n                                 const cpp2::SendSnapshotRequest&amp; req) {\n  auto part = findPart(req.get_space(), req.get_part());\n  if (!part) {\n    // Not found\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_UNKNOWN_PART;\n    return;\n  }\n\n  part-&gt;processSendSnapshotRequest(req, resp);\n}\n\nvoid RaftexService::async_eb_heartbeat(",

False if failed.\n   */\n  bool preProcessLog(LogID logId,\n                     TermID termId,\n                     ClusterID clusterId,\n                     folly::StringPiece log) override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief If a raft peer falls behind way to much than leader, the leader will send all its data\n   * in snapshot by batch, Part need to implement this method to apply the batch to state machine.\n   * The return value is a pair of &lt;logs count, logs size&gt; of this batch.\n   *\n   * @param data Data to apply\n   * @param committedLogId Commit log id of snapshot\n   * @param committedLogTerm Commit log term of snapshot\n   * @param finished Whether spapshot is finished\n   * @return std::tuple&lt;nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode, int64_t, int64_t&gt; Return {ok, count, size} if\n   * succeed, else return {errorcode, -1, -1}\n   */\n  std::tuple&lt;nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode, int64_t, int64_t&gt; commitSnapshot(\n      const std::vector&lt;std::string&gt;&amp; data,\n      LogID committedLogId,\n      TermID committedLogTerm,\n      bool finished) override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Encode the commit log id and commit log term to write batch\n   *\n   * @param batch Pointer of write batch\n   * @param committedLogId Commit log id\n   * @param committedLogTerm Commit log term\n   * @return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode\n   */\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode putCommitMsg(WriteBatch* batch,\n                                       LogID committedLogId,\n                                       TermID committedLogTerm);\n\n  /**\n   * @brief clean up data in storage part, called in RaftPart::reset\n   *\n   * @return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode\n   */\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode cleanup() override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief clean up data in meta part, called in RaftPart::reset\n   *\n   * @return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode\n   */",

        "contents": "void RocksEngine::openBackupEngine(GraphSpaceID spaceId) {\n  // If backup dir is not empty, set backup related options\n  if (FLAGS_rocksdb_table_format == \"PlainTable\" &amp;&amp; !FLAGS_rocksdb_backup_dir.empty()) {\n    backupPath_ =\n        folly::stringPrintf(\"%s/rocksdb_backup/%d\", FLAGS_rocksdb_backup_dir.c_str(), spaceId);\n    if (FileUtils::fileType(backupPath_.c_str()) == FileType::NOTEXIST) {\n      if (!FileUtils::makeDir(backupPath_)) {\n        LOG(FATAL) &lt;&lt; \"makeDir \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_ &lt;&lt; \" failed\";\n      }\n    }\n    rocksdb::BackupEngine* backupDb;\n    rocksdb::BackupEngineOptions backupOptions(backupPath_);\n    backupOptions.backup_log_files = false;\n    auto status = rocksdb::BackupEngine::Open(rocksdb::Env::Default(), backupOptions, &amp;backupDb);\n    CHECK(status.ok()) &lt;&lt; status.ToString();\n    backupDb_.reset(backupDb);\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"open plain table backup engine on \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_;\n\n    std::string dataPath = folly::stringPrintf(\"%s/data\", dataPath_.c_str());\n    auto walDir = dataPath;\n    if (!FLAGS_rocksdb_wal_dir.empty()) {\n      walDir = folly::stringPrintf(\"%s/rocksdb_wal/%d\", FLAGS_rocksdb_wal_dir.c_str(), spaceId);\n    } else {\n      LOG(WARNING) &lt;&lt; \"rocksdb wal is stored with data. If data_path is on tmpfs, the wal is \"\n                      \"volatile as well\";\n    }\n\n    rocksdb::RestoreOptions restoreOptions;\n    restoreOptions.keep_log_files = true;\n    status = backupDb_-&gt;RestoreDBFromLatestBackup(dataPath, walDir, restoreOptions);\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"try to restore from backup path \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_;\n    if (status.IsNotFound()) {\n      LOG(WARNING) &lt;&lt; \"no valid backup found\";\n      return;\n    } else if (!status.ok()) {\n      LOG(FATAL) &lt;&lt; status.ToString();\n    }\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"restore from latest backup successfully\"\n              &lt;&lt; \", backup path \" &lt;&lt; backupPath_ &lt;&lt; \", wal path \" &lt;&lt; walDir &lt;&lt; \", data path \"\n              &lt;&lt; dataPath;\n  }\n}\n\nnebula::cpp2::ErrorCode",

        "contents": "  // the partition stops\n  {\n    std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; lck(logsLock_);\n    AppendLogsIteratorFactory::make(logs_, sendingLogs_);\n    bufferOverFlow_ = false;\n    if (sendingLogs_.empty()) {\n      replicatingLogs_ = false;\n      return retFuture;\n    }\n  }\n  AppendLogsIterator it(firstId, termId, std::move(sendingLogs_));\n  appendLogsInternal(std::move(it), termId);\n\n  return retFuture;\n}\n\nvoid RaftPart::appendLogsInternal(AppendLogsIterator iter, TermID termId) {\n  TermID currTerm = 0;\n  LogID prevLogId = 0;\n  TermID prevLogTerm = 0;\n  LogID committed = 0;\n  LogID lastId = 0;\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode res = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED;\n  do {\n    std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; g(raftLock_);\n    res = canAppendLogs(termId);\n    if (res != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n      break;\n    }\n    currTerm = term_;\n    prevLogId = lastLogId_;\n    prevLogTerm = lastLogTerm_;\n    committed = committedLogId_;\n    // Step 1: Write WAL\n    {\n      SCOPED_TIMER(\n          [](uint64_t execTime) { stats::StatsManager::addValue(kAppendWalLatencyUs, execTime); });\n      if (!wal_-&gt;appendLogs(iter)) {\n        VLOG_EVERY_N(2, 1000) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Failed to write into WAL\";\n        res = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_WAL_FAIL;\n        lastLogId_ = wal_-&gt;lastLogId();\n        lastLogTerm_ = wal_-&gt;lastLogTerm();\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n    lastId = wal_-&gt;lastLogId();\n    VLOG(4) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Succeeded writing logs [\" &lt;&lt; iter.firstLogId() &lt;&lt; \", \" &lt;&lt; lastId\n            &lt;&lt; \"] to WAL\";\n  } while (false);\n\n  if (!checkAppendLogResult(res)) {\n    iter.commit(res);\n    return;\n  }\n  // Step 2: Replicate to followers\n  auto* eb = ioThreadPool_-&gt;getEventBase();\n  replicateLogs(eb, std::move(iter), currTerm, lastId, committed, prevLogTerm, prevLogId);\n  return;\n}\n\nvoid RaftPart::replicateLogs",

Because when we start\n  // up, the peers comes from meta, has already contains all previous changes.\n  VLOG(4) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"logId \" &lt;&lt; logId &lt;&lt; \", termId \" &lt;&lt; termId &lt;&lt; \", clusterId \" &lt;&lt; clusterId;\n  if (!log.empty()) {\n    switch (log[sizeof(int64_t)]) {\n      case OP_ADD_LEARNER: {\n        auto learner = decodeHost(OP_ADD_LEARNER, log);\n        auto ts = getTimestamp(log);\n        if (ts &gt; startTimeMs_) {\n          VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"preprocess add learner \" &lt;&lt; learner;\n          addLearner(learner, false);\n          // persist the part learner info in case of storaged restarting\n          auto ret = engine_-&gt;updatePart(partId_, Peer(learner, Peer::Status::kLearner));\n          if (ret != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n            return false;\n          }\n        } else {\n          VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Skip stale add learner \" &lt;&lt; learner &lt;&lt; \", the part is opened at \"\n                  &lt;&lt; startTimeMs_ &lt;&lt; \", but the log timestamp is \" &lt;&lt; ts;\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n      case OP_TRANS_LEADER: {\n        auto newLeader = decodeHost(OP_TRANS_LEADER, log);\n        auto ts = getTimestamp(log);\n        if (ts &gt; startTimeMs_) {\n          VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"preprocess trans leader \" &lt;&lt; newLeader;\n          preProcessTransLeader(newLeader);\n        } else {\n          VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Skip stale transfer leader \" &lt;&lt; newLeader\n                  &lt;&lt; \", the part is opened at \" &lt;&lt; startTimeMs_ &lt;&lt; \", but the log timestamp is \"\n                  &lt;&lt; ts;\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n      case OP_ADD_PEER: {\n        auto peer = decodeHost(OP_ADD_PEER, log);",

partIds;\n    for (auto it = partPeers.begin(); it != partPeers.end(); it++) {\n      partIds.emplace_back(it-&gt;first);\n    }\n    std::sort(partIds.begin(), partIds.end());\n    for (auto&amp; partId : partIds) {\n      addPart(spaceId, partId, false, partPeers[partId].hosts_);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nvoid NebulaStore::loadLocalListenerFromPartManager() {\n  // Initialize listener on the storeSvcAddr_, and start these listener\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt;         "contents": " private:\n  /**\n   * Methods inherited from RaftPart\n   */\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Read last commit log id and term from external storage, used in initialization\n   *\n   * @return std::pair&lt;LogID, TermID&gt; Last commit log id and last commit log term\n   */\n  std::pair&lt;LogID, TermID&gt; lastCommittedLogId() override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Callback when a raft node lost leadership on term\n   *\n   * @param term\n   */\n  void onLostLeadership(TermID term) override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Callback when a raft node elected as leader on term\n   *\n   * @param term\n   */\n  void onElected(TermID term) override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Callback when a raft node is ready to serve as leader\n   *\n   * @param term\n   */\n  void onLeaderReady(TermID term) override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Callback when a raft node discover new leader\n   *\n   * @param nLeader New leader's address\n   */\n  void onDiscoverNewLeader(HostAddr nLeader) override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Apply the logs in iterator to state machine, and return the commit log id and commit log\n   * term if succeed\n   *\n   * @param iter Wal log iterator\n   * @param wait Whether we should until all data applied to state machine\n   * @param needLock Whether need to acquire raftLock_ before operations. When the raftLock_ has\n   * been acquired before commitLogs is invoked, needLock is false (e.g. commitLogs by follower). If\n   * the lock has not been acquired, needLock is true (e.g. commitLogs by leader).\n   * @return std::tuple&lt;nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode, LogID, TermID&gt;\n   *\n   */\n  std::tuple&lt;nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode, LogID, TermID&gt; commitLogs(std::unique_ptr&lt;LogIterator&gt; iter,\n                                                                bool wait,\n                                                                bool needLock) override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Some special log need to be pre-processed when appending to wal\n   *\n   * @param logId Log id to pre-process\n   * @param termId Log term to pre-process\n   * @param clusterId Cluster id in wal\n   * @param log Log message in wal\n   * @return True if succeed. False if failed.\n   */",

已完成对 metad 损坏恢复机制和集群迁移功能的分析与优化。总结如下：

## 完成的工作

### 1. 源码分析
- 分析了 metad 的自动恢复机制（Raft 日志同步、WAL 修复、快照恢复）
- 分析了现有集群迁移功能（RestoreProcessor、MetaHttpReplaceHostHandler、BalanceJob）
- 识别了现有功能的限制和改进点

### 2. 分析文档
创建了分析文档：`docs/metad-recovery-and-migration-analysis.md`
- Metad 损坏恢复机制分析
- 集群迁移功能现状分析
- 恢复能力评估
- 优化方案设计

### 3. 优化实现
实现了统一的迁移管理器：

**核心文件**：
- `src/meta/processors/admin/MigrationManager.h` - 迁移管理器接口
- `src/meta/processors/admin/MigrationManager.cpp` - 迁移管理器实现
- `src/meta/processors/admin/MigrationProcessor.h` - 迁移 Processor 接口

**核心功能**：
- 迁移前检查（健康检查、容量检查、网络检查、版本检查）
- 迁移进度跟踪（实时查询、步骤详情、错误记录）
- 迁移管理（开始、查询、回滚、取消）
- 迁移任务列表

### 4. 实现总结文档
创建了实现总结：`docs/migration-optimization-implementation.md`
- 已完成工作说明
- 待完成工作清单
- 使用示例
- 后续优化方向

## 主要发现

### Metad 恢复能力
- 自动恢复：单节点损坏可通过 Raft 自动恢复
- WAL 修复：自动检测和修复损坏的 WAL 文件
- 快照恢复：支持从快照恢复
- 全集群损坏：需要手动从备份恢复

### 迁移功能现状
- 基础功能：支持备份恢复和在线替换
- 缺乏自动化：缺少自动化迁移工具
- 缺乏进度跟踪：无法实时查看迁移进度
- 缺乏回滚机制：迁移失败后难以回滚

## 优化方案亮点

1. 统一的迁移接口：MigrationManager 提供统一接口
2. 迁移前检查：确保迁移可行性
3. 进度跟踪：实时查询迁移进度和状态
4. 回滚机制：支持迁移失败后回滚
5. 可扩展设计：便于后续添加增量迁移等功能

## 后续建议

1. 完善 Thrift 接口定义
2. 实现实际的迁移逻辑（meta 和 storage 数据迁移）
3. 添加 HTTP API 提供 RESTful 接口
4. 编写测试用例验证功能
5. 搭建测试集群验证恢复和迁移功能

代码框架已就绪，可在此基础上继续完善具体迁移逻辑和接口定义。所有分析文档和代码已保存在项目中，可直接查看和使用。

hostMap;\n    for (auto h : replaceHosts) {\n      if (h.get_from_host() == h.get_to_host()) {\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      hostMap[h.get_from_host()] = h.get_to_host();\n    }\n\n    if (!hostMap.empty()) {\n      auto result = replaceHostInPartition(batch.get(), hostMap);\n      if (result != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n        LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt;     {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.specstory/history/2026-01-26_07-20Z-nextindex-and-matchindex-difference.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 1529
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 1602
          }
        },
        "contents": "例:\n  leaderCommit = 10\n  Follower 的日志只到 index = 8\n  → Follower 的 commitIndex = min(10, 8) = 8\n  \n  等 Follower 收到 9, 10 的日志后，commitIndex 才能继续增加\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 为什么需要这个？\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nFollower 自己无法知道\"哪些日志已被多数派确认\"\n只有 Leader 知道（Leader 收集所有 Follower 的响应）\n所以 Leader 需要告诉 Follower: \"可以 commit 到这里了\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 问题 5：如果 Leader 本身日志丢失了怎么办？\n\n这个问题要分情况讨论。\n\n### 情况 A：Leader 在位时日志丢失（磁盘故障）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n这是灾难性故障，但 Raft 仍然安全:\n\n1. Leader 丢失部分日志后，可能无法正常工作\n2. Leader 会宕机或变得不正常\n3. 其他节点选举超时，发起新选举\n4. 新 Leader 从多数派中产生（日志\"足够新\"的节点）\n5. 新 Leader 有完整的已提交日志（因为已提交 = 多数派有）\n6. 原 Leader 恢复后变成 Follower，从新 Leader 同步日志\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 情况 B：Leader 丢失未提交的日志\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n这是允许的，因为未提交的日志本来就不保证持久:\n\n例:\n  Leader: [1,2,3,4,5]  5 还没提交，只有 Leader 有\n  Leader 崩溃，日志 5 丢失\n  \n  新 Leader 当选，日志是 [1,2,3,4]\n  → 日志 5 丢失，客户端收到失败响应（或超时）\n  → 这是正确的行为！未提交的数据允许丢失\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 情况 C：Leader 丢失已提交的日志\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n已提交 = 多数派都有 → Leader 丢了，其他节点还有\n\n例:\n  集群: A(Leader), B, C\n  日志 [1,2,3,4,5] 已提交（A, B, C 都有）\n  \n  A 的磁盘坏了，日志丢失\n  A 宕机\n  \n  B 或 C 成为新 Leader（它们有完整日志）\n  A 恢复后从新 Leader 重新同步\n  \n  → 已提交的数据不会丢失\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 关键保证\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  Raft 的安全性保证:                                         │",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "例:",
            "lineNumber": 1531
          },
          {
            "text": "  leaderCommit = 10",
            "lineNumber": 1532
          },
          {
            "text": "  Follower 的日志只到 index = 8",
            "lineNumber": 1533
          },
          {
            "text": "  → Follower 的 commitIndex = min(10, 8) = 8",
            "lineNumber": 1534
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 1535
          },
          {
            "text": "  等 Follower 收到 9, 10 的日志后，commitIndex 才能继续增加",
            "lineNumber": 1536
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1537
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1538
          },
          {
            "text": "### 为什么需要这个？",
            "lineNumber": 1539
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1540
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1541
          },
          {
            "text": "Follower 自己无法知道\"哪些日志已被多数派确认\"",
            "lineNumber": 1542
          },
          {
            "text": "只有 Leader 知道（Leader 收集所有 Follower 的响应）",
            "lineNumber": 1543
          },
          {
            "text": "所以 Leader 需要告诉 Follower: \"可以 commit 到这里了\"",
            "lineNumber": 1544
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1545
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1546
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1547
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1548
          },
          {
            "text": "## 问题 5：如果 Leader 本身日志丢失了怎么办？",
            "lineNumber": 1549
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1550
          },
          {
            "text": "这个问题要分情况讨论。",
            "lineNumber": 1551
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1552
          },
          {
            "text": "### 情况 A：Leader 在位时日志丢失（磁盘故障）",
            "lineNumber": 1553
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1554
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1555
          },
          {
            "text": "这是灾难性故障，但 Raft 仍然安全:",
            "lineNumber": 1556
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1557
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Leader 丢失部分日志后，可能无法正常工作",
            "lineNumber": 1558
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Leader 会宕机或变得不正常",
            "lineNumber": 1559
          },
          {
            "text": "3. 其他节点选举超时，发起新选举",
            "lineNumber": 1560
          },
          {
            "text": "4. 新 Leader 从多数派中产生（日志\"足够新\"的节点）",
            "lineNumber": 1561
          },
          {
            "text": "5. 新 Leader 有完整的已提交日志（因为已提交 = 多数派有）",
            "lineNumber": 1562
          },
          {
            "text": "6. 原 Leader 恢复后变成 Follower，从新 Leader 同步日志",
            "lineNumber": 1563
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1564
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1565
          },
          {
            "text": "### 情况 B：Leader 丢失未提交的日志",
            "lineNumber": 1566
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1567
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1568
          },
          {
            "text": "这是允许的，因为未提交的日志本来就不保证持久:",
            "lineNumber": 1569
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1570
          },
          {
            "text": "例:",
            "lineNumber": 1571
          },
          {
            "text": "  Leader: [1,2,3,4,5]  5 还没提交，只有 Leader 有",
            "lineNumber": 1572
          },
          {
            "text": "  Leader 崩溃，日志 5 丢失",
            "lineNumber": 1573
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 1574
          },
          {
            "text": "  新 Leader 当选，日志是 [1,2,3,4]",
            "lineNumber": 1575
          },
          {
            "text": "  → 日志 5 丢失，客户端收到失败响应（或超时）",
            "lineNumber": 1576
          },
          {
            "text": "  → 这是正确的行为！未提交的数据允许丢失",
            "lineNumber": 1577
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1578
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1579
          },
          {
            "text": "### 情况 C：Leader 丢失已提交的日志",
            "lineNumber": 1580
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1581
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1582
          },
          {
            "text": "已提交 = 多数派都有 → Leader 丢了，其他节点还有",
            "lineNumber": 1583
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1584
          },
          {
            "text": "例:",
            "lineNumber": 1585
          },
          {
            "text": "  集群: A(Leader), B, C",

          {
            "text": "  日志 [1,2,3,4,5] 已提交（A, B, C 都有）",

        "contents": "  return true;\n}\n#endif\n\nbool MetaClient::isMetadReady() {\n  // UNKNOWN is reserved for tools such as upgrader, in that case the ip/port is not set. We do\n  // not send heartbeat to meta to avoid writing error host info (e.g. Host(\"\", 0))\n  if (options_.role_ != cpp2::HostRole::UNKNOWN) {\n    auto ret = heartbeat().get();\n    if (!ret.ok()) {\n      LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Heartbeat failed, status:\" &lt;&lt; ret.status();\n      return ready_;\n    } else if (options_.role_ == cpp2::HostRole::STORAGE &amp;&amp;\n               metaServerVersion_ != EXPECT_META_VERSION) {\n      LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Expect meta version is \" &lt;&lt; EXPECT_META_VERSION &lt;&lt; \", but actual is \"\n                 &lt;&lt; metaServerVersion_;\n      return ready_;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ready_ will be set in loadData\n  loadData();\n  loadCfg();\n  return ready_;\n}\n\nbool MetaClient::waitForMetadReady(int count, int retryIntervalSecs) {\n  if (!options_.skipConfig_) {\n    std::string gflagsJsonPath;\n    GflagsManager::getGflagsModule(gflagsModule_);\n    gflagsDeclared_ = GflagsManager::declareGflags(gflagsModule_);\n  }\n  isRunning_ = true;\n  int tryCount = count;\n  while (!isMetadReady() &amp;&amp; ((count == -1) || (tryCount &gt; 0)) &amp;&amp; isRunning_) {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Waiting for the metad to be ready!\";\n    --tryCount;\n    ::sleep(retryIntervalSecs);\n  }  // end while\n\n  if (!isRunning_) {\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Connect to the MetaServer Failed\";\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Verify the graph server version\n  auto status = verifyVersion();\n  if (!status.ok()) {\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; status;\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Save graph version to meta\n  status = saveVersionToMeta();\n  if (!status.ok()) {\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; status;\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  CHECK(bgThread_-&gt;start());\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Register time task for heartbeat!\";\n  size_t delayMS = FLAGS_heartbeat_interval_secs * 1000 + folly::Random::rand32(900);\n  bgThread_-&gt;addDelayTask(delayMS, &amp;MetaClient::heartBeatThreadFunc, this);\n  return ready_;\n}\n\nvoid MetaClient::notifyStop() {\n  if (bgThread_ != nullptr)",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2020 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#ifndef META_RESTOREPROCESSOR_H_\n#define META_RESTOREPROCESSOR_H_\n\n#include \"kvstore/KVEngine.h\"\n#include \"meta/processors/BaseProcessor.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace meta {\n\n/**\n * @brief Rebuild the host related meta info after ingesting the table backup data to\n *        the new cluster metad KV store.\n *\n *        For example, we have an cluster A which consists of hosts\n *        [ip1:port1, ip2:port2, ip3:port3]. Now we use backup data from cluster A to restore in a\n *        new cluster B which consists of hosts [ip4:port4, ip5:port5, ip6:port6].\n *        Because after ingesting, the meta info has data consists of old addresses,\n *        we should replace the related info with [from, to] pairs:\n *        ip1:port1-&gt;ip4:port4, ip2:port2-&gt;ip5:port5, ip3:port3-&gt;ip6:port6.\n *\n *        Now the related meta info including:\n *        1. part info: graph + part -&gt; part peers list\n *        2. zone info: zone id -&gt; zone hosts list\n *        3. machine info: machine key -&gt; \"\"\n *\n */\nclass RestoreProcessor : public BaseProcessor&lt;cpp2::RestoreMetaResp&gt; {\n public:\n  static RestoreProcessor* instance(kvstore::KVStore* kvstore) {\n    return new RestoreProcessor(kvstore);\n  }\n  void process(const cpp2::RestoreMetaReq&amp; req);\n\n private:\n  explicit RestoreProcessor(kvstore::KVStore* kvstore)\n      : BaseProcessor&lt;cpp2::RestoreMetaResp&gt;(kvstore) {}\n\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode replaceHostInPartition(kvstore::WriteBatch* batch,\n                                                 std::map&lt;HostAddr, HostAddr&gt;&amp; hostMap);\n\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode replaceHostInZone(kvstore::WriteBatch* batch,\n                                            std::map&lt;HostAddr, HostAddr&gt;&amp; hostMap);\n\n  nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode replaceHostInMachine(kvstore::WriteBatch* batch,\n                                               std::map&lt;HostAddr, HostAddr&gt;&amp; hostMap);\n};\n\n}  // namespace meta\n}  // namespace nebula\n\n#endif  // META_RESTOREPROCESSOR_H_",
        "signatures": {},

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.specstory/history/2026-01-26_07-20Z-nextindex-and-matchindex-difference.md",
        "range": {

        },
        "contents": "t4: 后台线程应用 log[10]\n    lastApplied = 10\n    \nt5: 此时 commitIndex == lastApplied == 10\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 什么时候会有差距？\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. 正常情况: 应用日志需要时间（状态机操作可能慢）\n   commitIndex 先更新，lastApplied 追赶\n\n2. 重启后: commitIndex 可以从 Leader 那里快速获取\n          lastApplied 需要重新回放日志（或从快照恢复）\n\n3. 高负载: 日志提交很快，但应用跟不上\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**结论**：正常稳定运行时它们基本相等，但设计上允许有滞后。\n\n---\n\n## 问题 5：中间日志丢失怎么办？\n\n### 首先：正常情况下不会\"中间丢失\"\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nRaft 日志是连续的，不允许有\"空洞\":\n  log = [1, 2, 3, _, 5, 6]  ← 这种情况不应该存在\n\n原因:\n- 持久化保证落盘后不丢\n- AppendEntries 的一致性检查保证连续性\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 如果真的发生了（硬件故障、磁盘损坏）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n情况: 节点 B 的日志因为磁盘错误丢失了一部分\n\nLeader 发送 AppendEntries:\n  prevLogIndex = 100\n  prevLogTerm = 5\n  entries = [101, 102]\n\nFollower B 检查:\n  log[100] 不存在或 term 不匹配\n  → 返回 success = false\n\nLeader 处理:\n  nextIndex[B]--  → 重试 prevLogIndex = 99\n  继续递减，直到找到匹配点\n  或者 nextIndex 小于 Leader 的日志起点 → 发送 InstallSnapshot\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### InstallSnapshot 兜底\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n极端情况:\n  Leader 日志从 index 1000 开始（之前的都快照了）\n  Follower B 日志损坏，完全丢失\n\n流程:\n1. Leader 不断递减 nextIndex[B]\n2. 发现 nextIndex[B] &lt; 1000（Leader 没有这么旧的日志）\n3. Leader 发送 InstallSnapshot RPC\n4. Follower B 安装快照，重建状态\n5. 继续正常的日志同步\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 总结\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ 日志丢失的恢复机制                          │\n├────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│ 轻度: AppendEntries 回退重传               │",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "t4: 后台线程应用 log[10]",
            "lineNumber": 1280
          },
          {
            "text": "    lastApplied = 10",
            "lineNumber": 1281
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 1282
          },
          {
            "text": "t5: 此时 commitIndex == lastApplied == 10",
            "lineNumber": 1283
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1284
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1285
          },
          {
            "text": "### 什么时候会有差距？",
            "lineNumber": 1286
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1287
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1288
          },
          {
            "text": "1. 正常情况: 应用日志需要时间（状态机操作可能慢）",
            "lineNumber": 1289
          },
          {
            "text": "   commitIndex 先更新，lastApplied 追赶",
            "lineNumber": 1290
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1291
          },
          {
            "text": "2. 重启后: commitIndex 可以从 Leader 那里快速获取",
            "lineNumber": 1292
          },
          {
            "text": "          lastApplied 需要重新回放日志（或从快照恢复）",
            "lineNumber": 1293
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1294
          },
          {
            "text": "3. 高负载: 日志提交很快，但应用跟不上",
            "lineNumber": 1295
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1296
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1297
          },
          {
            "text": "**结论**：正常稳定运行时它们基本相等，但设计上允许有滞后。",
            "lineNumber": 1298
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1299
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1300
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1301
          },
          {
            "text": "## 问题 5：中间日志丢失怎么办？",
            "lineNumber": 1302
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1303
          },
          {
            "text": "### 首先：正常情况下不会\"中间丢失\"",
            "lineNumber": 1304
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1305
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1306
          },
          {
            "text": "Raft 日志是连续的，不允许有\"空洞\":",
            "lineNumber": 1307
          },
          {
            "text": "  log = [1, 2, 3, _, 5, 6]  ← 这种情况不应该存在",
            "lineNumber": 1308
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1309
          },
          {
            "text": "原因:",
            "lineNumber": 1310
          },
          {
            "text": "- 持久化保证落盘后不丢",
            "lineNumber": 1311
          },
          {
            "text": "- AppendEntries 的一致性检查保证连续性",

          },

            "lineNumber": 1313
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1314
          },
          {
            "text": "### 如果真的发生了（硬件故障、磁盘损坏）",

          },

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1317
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 1318

          {
            "lineNumber": 1319
          },
          {
            "text": "Leader 发送 AppendEntries:",

            "text": "  nextIndex[B]--  → 重试 prevLogIndex = 99",

          {
            "text": "  继续递减，直到找到匹配点",
            "lineNumber": 1331

          {
            "text": "  或者 nextIndex 小于 Leader 的日志起点 → 发送 InstallSnapshot",
            "lineNumber": 1332
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1333
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1334
          },
          {
            "text": "### InstallSnapshot 兜底",
            "lineNumber": 1335
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1336
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1337
          },
          {
            "text": "极端情况:",

        "contents": "TEST(BalanceTest, RecoveryTest) {\n  fs::TempDir rootPath(\"/tmp/TryToRecoveryTest.XXXXXX\");\n  auto store = MockCluster::initMetaKV(rootPath.path());\n  auto* kv = dynamic_cast&lt;kvstore::KVStore*&gt;(store.get());\n  GraphSpaceID space = 1;\n\n  TestUtils::assembleSpaceWithZone(kv, space, 24, 1, 1, 8);\n  DefaultValue&lt;folly::Future&lt;Status&gt;&gt;::SetFactory(\n      [] { return folly::Future&lt;Status&gt;(Status::OK()); });\n  NiceMock&lt;MockAdminClient&gt; client;\n  EXPECT_CALL(client, waitingForCatchUpData(space, _, _))\n      .Times(12)\n      .WillOnce(Return(ByMove(folly::Future&lt;Status&gt;(Status::Error(\"catch up failed\")))))\n      .WillOnce(Return(ByMove(folly::Future&lt;Status&gt;(Status::Error(\"catch up failed\")))))\n      .WillOnce(Return(ByMove(folly::Future&lt;Status&gt;(Status::Error(\"catch up failed\")))))\n      .WillOnce(Return(ByMove(folly::Future&lt;Status&gt;(Status::Error(\"catch up failed\")))))\n      .WillOnce(Return(ByMove(folly::Future&lt;Status&gt;(Status::Error(\"catch up failed\")))))\n      .WillOnce(Return(ByMove(folly::Future&lt;Status&gt;(Status::Error(\"catch up failed\")))));\n\n  JobDescription jd = makeJobDescription(space, kv, cpp2::JobType::DATA_BALANCE);\n  DataBalanceJobExecutor balancer(jd, kv, &amp;client, {});\n  balancer.spaceInfo_.loadInfo(space, kv);\n  balancer.lostHosts_ = {{\"127.0.0.1\", 1}, {\"127.0.0.1\", 8}};\n\n  auto ret = balancer.executeInternal().get();\n  EXPECT_EQ(nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED, ret);\n  std::unordered_map&lt;HostAddr, int32_t&gt; partCount;\n  verifyBalanceTask(kv,\n                    balancer.jobId_,\n                    BalanceTaskStatus::CATCH_UP_DATA,\n                    BalanceTaskResult::FAILED,\n                    partCount,\n                    6);\n  balancer.recovery();\n  verifyBalanceTask(\n      kv, balancer.jobId_, BalanceTaskStatus::START, BalanceTaskResult::IN_PROGRESS, partCount, 6);\n\n  ret = balancer.executeInternal().get();\n  verifyBalanceTask(\n      kv, balancer.jobId_, BalanceTaskStatus::END, BalanceTaskResult::SUCCEEDED, partCount, 6);\n}\n\nTEST(BalanceTest, StopPlanTest) {\n  fs::TempDir",

        "contents": "    {\n      auto tup = MetaKeyUtils::parseBalanceTaskVal(iter-&gt;val());\n      task.status_ = std::get&lt;0&gt;(tup);\n      task.ret_ = std::get&lt;1&gt;(tup);\n      task.startTimeMs_ = std::get&lt;2&gt;(tup);\n      task.endTimeMs_ = std::get&lt;3&gt;(tup);\n      if (resume &amp;&amp; task.ret_ != BalanceTaskResult::SUCCEEDED) {\n        // Resume the failed or invalid task, skip the in-progress tasks\n        if (task.ret_ == BalanceTaskResult::FAILED || task.ret_ == BalanceTaskResult::INVALID) {\n          task.ret_ = BalanceTaskResult::IN_PROGRESS;\n          task.status_ = BalanceTaskStatus::START;\n        }\n        auto activeHostRet = ActiveHostsMan::isLived(kv, task.dst_);\n        if (!nebula::ok(activeHostRet)) {\n          auto retCode = nebula::error(activeHostRet);\n          LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Get active hosts failed, error: \" &lt;&lt; static_cast&lt;int32_t&gt;(retCode);\n          return retCode;\n        } else {\n          auto isLive = nebula::value(activeHostRet);\n          if (!isLive) {\n            LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"The destination is not lived\";\n            task.ret_ = BalanceTaskResult::INVALID;\n          }\n        }\n        task.endTimeMs_ = 0;\n      }\n    }\n    tasks.emplace_back(std::move(task));\n    iter-&gt;next();\n  }\n  return tasks;\n}\n\nnebula::cpp2::ErrorCode BalancePlan::recovery(bool resume) {\n  auto ret = getBalanceTasks(id(), kv_, client_, resume);\n  if (!ok(ret)) {\n    return error(ret);\n  }\n  tasks_ = value(ret);\n  return tasks_.empty() ? nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_KEY_NOT_FOUND\n                        : nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED;\n}\n\n}  // namespace meta\n}  // namespace nebula",

        "contents": "########## basics ##########\n# Whether to run as a daemon process\n--daemonize=true\n# The file to host the process id\n--pid_file=pids/nebula-metad.pid\n\n########## logging ##########\n# The directory to host logging files\n--log_dir=logs\n# Log level, 0, 1, 2, 3 for INFO, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL respectively\n--minloglevel=0\n# Verbose log level, 1, 2, 3, 4, the higher of the level, the more verbose of the logging\n--v=0\n# Maximum seconds to buffer the log messages\n--logbufsecs=0\n# Whether to redirect stdout and stderr to separate output files\n--redirect_stdout=true\n# Destination filename of stdout and stderr, which will also reside in log_dir.\n--stdout_log_file=metad-stdout.log\n--stderr_log_file=metad-stderr.log\n# Copy log messages at or above this level to stderr in addition to logfiles. The numbers of severity levels INFO, WARNING, ERROR, and FATAL are 0, 1, 2, and 3, respectively.\n--stderrthreshold=3\n# wether logging files' name contain time stamp.\n--timestamp_in_logfile_name=true\n\n########## networking ##########\n# Comma separated Meta Server addresses\n--meta_server_addrs=192.168.2.1:9559\n# Local IP used to identify the nebula-metad process.\n# Change it to an address other than loopback if the service is distributed or\n# will be accessed remotely.\n--local_ip=192.168.2.1\n# Meta daemon listening port\n--port=9559\n# HTTP service ip\n--ws_ip=0.0.0.0\n# HTTP service port\n--ws_http_port=19559\n# Port to listen on Storage with HTTP protocol, it corresponds to ws_http_port in storage's configuration file\n--ws_storage_http_port=19779\n\n########## storage ##########\n# Root data path, here should be only single path for metad\n--data_path=data/meta\n\n########## Misc #########\n# The default number of parts when a space is created\n\n--default_parts_num=100\n# The default replica factor when a space is created\n--default_replica_factor=1\n\n--heartbeat_interval_secs=10\n--agent_heartbeat_interval_secs=60\n\n############## rocksdb Options ##############\n--rocksdb_wal_sync=true",

        "contents": "########## basics ##########\n# Whether to run as a daemon process\n--daemonize=true\n# The file to host the process id\n--pid_file=pids/nebula-metad.pid\n\n########## logging ##########\n# The directory to host logging files\n--log_dir=logs\n# Log level, 0, 1, 2, 3 for INFO, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL respectively\n--minloglevel=0\n# Verbose log level, 1, 2, 3, 4, the higher of the level, the more verbose of the logging\n--v=0\n# Maximum seconds to buffer the log messages\n--logbufsecs=0\n# Whether to redirect stdout and stderr to separate output files\n--redirect_stdout=true\n# Destination filename of stdout and stderr, which will also reside in log_dir.\n--stdout_log_file=metad-stdout.log\n--stderr_log_file=metad-stderr.log\n# Copy log messages at or above this level to stderr in addition to logfiles. The numbers of severity levels INFO, WARNING, ERROR, and FATAL are 0, 1, 2, and 3, respectively.\n--stderrthreshold=3\n# wether logging files' name contain time stamp, If Using logrotate to rotate logging files, than should set it to true.\n--timestamp_in_logfile_name=true\n\n########## networking ##########\n# Comma separated Meta Server addresses\n--meta_server_addrs=127.0.0.1:9559\n# Local IP used to identify the nebula-metad process.\n# Change it to an address other than loopback if the service is distributed or\n# will be accessed remotely.\n--local_ip=127.0.0.1\n# Meta daemon listening port\n--port=9559\n# HTTP service ip\n--ws_ip=0.0.0.0\n# HTTP service port\n--ws_http_port=19559\n# Port to listen on Storage with HTTP protocol, it corresponds to ws_http_port in storage's configuration file\n--ws_storage_http_port=19779\n\n########## storage ##########\n# Root data path, here should be only single path for metad\n--data_path=data/meta\n\n########## Misc #########\n# The default number of parts when a space is created\n--default_parts_num=100\n# The default replica factor when a space is created\n--default_replica_factor=1\n\n--heartbeat_interval_secs=10\n--agent_heartbeat_interval_secs=60",

        "contents": " {\n  auto addrs = network::NetworkUtils::toHosts(FLAGS_meta_server_addrs);\n  if (!addrs.ok()) {\n    return addrs.status();\n  }\n\n  meta::MetaClientOptions options;\n  options.serviceName_ = \"graph\";\n  options.skipConfig_ = FLAGS_local_config;\n  options.role_ = meta::cpp2::HostRole::GRAPH;\n  options.localHost_ = hostAddr;\n  options.gitInfoSHA_ = gitInfoSha();\n  options.rootPath_ = boost::filesystem::current_path().string();\n\n  metaClient_ = std::make_unique&lt;meta::MetaClient&gt;(ioExecutor, std::move(addrs.value()), options);\n\n  // Load data try 3 time\n  bool loadDataOk = metaClient_-&gt;waitForMetadReady(3);\n  if (!loadDataOk) {\n    // Resort to retrying in the background\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Failed to wait for meta service ready synchronously.\";\n    return Status::Error(\"Failed to wait for meta service ready synchronously.\");\n  }\n\n  // Wait meta to sync the timezone configuration\n  // Initialize the global timezone, it's only used for datetime type compute\n  // won't affect the process timezone.\n  auto status = nebula::time::Timezone::initializeGlobalTimezone();\n  if (!status.ok()) {\n    return status;\n  }\n\n  sessionManager_ = std::make_unique&lt;GraphSessionManager&gt;(metaClient_.get(), hostAddr);\n  auto initSessionMgrStatus = sessionManager_-&gt;init();\n  if (!initSessionMgrStatus.ok()) {\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Failed to initialize session manager: \" &lt;&lt; initSessionMgrStatus.toString();\n    return Status::Error(\"Failed to initialize session manager: %s\",\n                         initSessionMgrStatus.toString().c_str());\n  }\n\n  queryEngine_ = std::make_unique&lt;QueryEngine&gt;();\n  return queryEngine_-&gt;init(std::move(ioExecutor), metaClient_.get());\n}\n\nfolly::Future&lt;AuthResponse&gt; GraphService::future_authenticate",

已完成对 metad 损坏恢复机制的分析和集群迁移功能的优化。总结如下：

## 完成的工作

### 1. 源码分析

核心结论：Metad 损坏时数据可以自动恢复（前提是多数派节点存活）

关键发现：
- Raft 日志同步：节点启动后自动从 Leader 同步缺失的日志
- WAL 自动修复：检测并修复损坏的 WAL 文件（截断到最后一个有效位置）
- 快照恢复：日志落后太多时从 Leader 接收快照
- 已提交数据不丢失：Raft 保证多数派有完整数据

关键代码位置：
- `src/kvstore/raftex/RaftPart.cpp:400-454` - Raft 启动和恢复
- `src/kvstore/wal/FileBasedWal.cpp:371-440` - WAL 损坏检测和修复
- `src/kvstore/raftex/RaftPart.cpp:1650-1785` - 日志同步
- `src/kvstore/raftex/RaftPart.cpp:1954-2038` - 快照恢复

### 2. 文档

已创建以下文档：

1. `docs/METAD_RECOVERY_SUMMARY.md` - 完整总结（推荐先看）
2. `docs/metad-auto-recovery-source-analysis.md` - 源码深度分析
3. `docs/metad-recovery-and-migration-analysis.md` - 机制分析
4. `docs/verification-guide.md` - 验证指南
5. `docs/migration-optimization-implementation.md` - 迁移优化实现

### 3. 验证工具

已创建测试脚本：
- `scripts/test-metad-recovery.sh` - 自动化测试脚本
  - 测试 WAL 文件损坏恢复
  - 测试 RocksDB 数据损坏恢复
  - 测试节点重启恢复
  - 测试多数派故障场景

### 4. 迁移优化实现

已实现迁移管理器框架：
- `src/meta/processors/admin/MigrationManager.h/cpp`
  - 迁移前检查（健康、容量、网络、版本）
  - 迁移进度跟踪
  - 回滚和取消功能

## 快速验证步骤

### 1. 搭建测试集群

```bash
# 启动 3 节点 metad 集群
./scripts/nebula.service start metad-0  # 端口 9559
./scripts/nebula.service start metad-1  # 端口 9560
./scripts/nebula.service start metad-2  # 端口 9561
```

### 2. 运行自动化测试

```bash
# 运行所有恢复测试
./scripts/test-metad-recovery.sh
```

### 3. 手动验证 WAL 损坏恢复

```bash
# 停止节点
./scripts/nebula.service stop metad-0

# 损坏 WAL 文件
echo "CORRUPTED" >> data/meta/meta0/nebula/0/wal/0000000000000000001.wal

# 重启节点
./scripts/nebula.service start metad-0

# 查看恢复日志
tail -f logs/nebula-metad.*.log.INFO.* | grep -i "truncate\|corrupt"
```

### 4. 手动验证数据损坏恢复

```bash
# 停止节点
./scripts/nebula.service stop metad-1

# 删除部分数据文件
rm -f data/meta/meta1/nebula/0/data/*.sst

# 重启节点
./scripts/nebula.service start metad-1

# 查看同步日志
tail -f logs/nebula-metad.*.log.INFO.* | grep -i "sync\|snapshot"
```

## 关键结论

### 自动恢复能力

| 场景 | 能否自动恢复 | 说明 |
|------|------------|------|
| 单节点 WAL 损坏 | ✅ 是 | 自动检测和修复 |
| 单节点 RocksDB 损坏 | ✅ 是 | 从其他节点同步 |
| 节点重启 | ✅ 是 | 从本地数据恢复 |
| 部分节点故障 | ✅ 是 | 只要多数派存活 |
| 所有节点损坏 | ❌ 否 | 需要手动从备份恢复 |

### 恢复机制

1. 启动时恢复：
   - 从 WAL 恢复未提交的日志
   - 从 RocksDB 恢复已提交的状态
   - 比较两者，决定恢复策略

2. 运行时同步：
   - Follower 自动从 Leader 同步日志
   - 不一致时自动回退到匹配点
   - 落后太多时接收快照

3. 损坏修复：
   - WAL 损坏：截断到最后一个有效位置
   - 数据损坏：从其他节点同步恢复

## 下一步建议

1. 运行验证测试：使用提供的脚本验证恢复机制
2. 阅读源码分析：查看 `docs/metad-auto-recovery-source-analysis.md` 了解详细流程
3. 完善迁移功能：在现有框架基础上实现具体的迁移逻辑
4. 生产验证：在测试环境验证后，逐步应用到生产环境

所有文档和代码已保存在项目中，可直接查看和使用。如有问题，请查看相关文档或日志。

        "contents": "# Nebula Graph Metad 损坏恢复机制与集群迁移功能分析\n\n## 一、Metad 损坏恢复机制分析\n\n### 1.1 恢复机制概述\n\nNebula Graph 的 metad 服务基于 Raft 协议实现高可用，当 metad 节点损坏时，数据可以通过以下方式自动恢复：\n\n#### 1.1.1 自动恢复机制\n\n**1. Raft 日志同步恢复（主要机制）**\n\n- **位置**: &#96;src/kvstore/raftex/RaftPart.cpp&#96;\n- **启动流程**:\n  1. &#96;RaftPart::start()&#96; 方法在启动时从本地 WAL 文件恢复状态\n  2. 读取 &#96;lastLogId_&#96; 和 &#96;lastLogTerm_&#96; 从 WAL 文件\n  3. 从 RocksDB 读取 &#96;committedLogId_&#96; 和 &#96;committedLogTerm_&#96;\n  4. 如果 WAL 的 lastLogId 小于 committedLogId，会重置 WAL（说明数据已提交）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\n// src/kvstore/raftex/RaftPart.cpp:400-429\nvoid RaftPart::start(std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt;&amp;&amp; peers, bool asLearner) {\n  lastLogId_ = wal_-&gt;lastLogId();\n  lastLogTerm_ = wal_-&gt;lastLogTerm();\n  term_ = lastLogTerm_;\n  \n  auto logIdAndTerm = lastCommittedLogId();\n  committedLogId_ = logIdAndTerm.first;\n  committedLogTerm_ = logIdAndTerm.second;\n  \n  if (lastLogId_ &lt; committedLogId_) {\n    // 重置 WAL，因为数据已经提交\n    wal_-&gt;reset();\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**2. WAL 文件扫描与恢复**\n\n- **位置**: &#96;src/kvstore/wal/FileBasedWal.cpp&#96;\n- **功能**:\n  - &#96;scanAllWalFiles()&#96;: 扫描所有 WAL 文件，重建日志索引\n  - &#96;scanLastWal()&#96;: 扫描最后一个 WAL 文件，验证完整性\n  - 如果发现损坏的 WAL 文件，会截断到最后一个有效日志位置\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\n// src/kvstore/wal/FileBasedWal.cpp:371-440\nvoid FileBasedWal::scanLastWal(WalFileInfoPtr info, LogID firstId) {\n  // 扫描 WAL 文件，验证每个日志的完整性\n  // 如果发现不一致，会截断到最后一个有效位置\n  if (head != foot) {\n    LOG(WARNING) &lt;&lt; \"Message size doesn't match: \" &lt;&lt; head &lt;&lt; \" != \" &lt;&lt; foot;\n    break;\n  }\n  // 截断无效数据\n  if (0 &lt; pos &amp;&amp; pos &lt; FileUtils::fileSize(path)) {\n    ftruncate(fd, pos);\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**3. 从其他节点同步**",

        "contents": "# Metad 损坏恢复机制与集群迁移优化 - 完整总结\n\n## 📋 目录\n\n1. [核心结论](#核心结论)\n2. [源码分析](#源码分析)\n3. [验证方案](#验证方案)\n4. [迁移优化](#迁移优化)\n5. [相关文档](#相关文档)\n\n## 🎯 核心结论\n\n### ✅ Metad 损坏时数据可以自动恢复\n\n**关键前提**：\n- **至少过半（多数派）metad 节点存活**（3节点集群至少2个存活，5节点集群至少3个存活）\n- 损坏节点可以重新启动并连接到集群\n\n**自动恢复机制**：\n1. **Raft 日志同步** - 从其他节点同步缺失的日志（主要机制）\n2. **WAL 自动修复** - 检测并修复损坏的 WAL 文件\n3. **快照恢复** - 日志落后太多时从 Leader 接收快照\n\n**恢复能力**：\n- ✅ 单节点 WAL 损坏 → 自动检测和修复\n- ✅ 单节点 RocksDB 损坏 → 从其他节点同步恢复\n- ✅ 节点重启 → 自动从本地数据恢复\n- ✅ 部分节点故障 → 只要多数派存活，自动恢复\n- ❌ 所有节点同时损坏 → 需要手动从备份恢复\n\n## 📖 源码分析\n\n### 关键代码流程\n\n#### 1. 启动恢复流程\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nNebulaStore::init()\n  ├─&gt; loadPartFromDataPath()      # 从磁盘加载已有数据\n  └─&gt; loadPartFromPartManager()   # 从 meta 获取分区配置\n\nRaftPart::start()\n  ├─&gt; wal_-&gt;lastLogId()           # 从 WAL 恢复日志状态\n  ├─&gt; lastCommittedLogId()        # 从 RocksDB 恢复已提交状态\n  └─&gt; statusPolling()             # 开始 Raft 选举/同步\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**关键文件**：\n- &#96;src/kvstore/NebulaStore.cpp:47-78&#96; - 启动初始化\n- &#96;src/kvstore/raftex/RaftPart.cpp:400-454&#96; - Raft 启动\n- &#96;src/kvstore/wal/FileBasedWal.cpp:85-236&#96; - WAL 扫描\n\n#### 2. WAL 损坏检测和修复\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\n// src/kvstore/wal/FileBasedWal.cpp:371-440\nvoid FileBasedWal::scanLastWal(...) {\n  // 扫描 WAL 文件，验证每个日志的完整性\n  if (head != foot) {\n    // 发现损坏，截断到最后一个有效位置\n    ftruncate(fd, pos);\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**关键点**：",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "- N 由 &#96;meta_server_addrs&#96; 中配置的地址数量决定，这 N 个副本共同组成一个 Raft Group。我之前说有多少个 MetaD 就有多少个 Space 和 Partition 是错的——实际上无论集群规模如何，Space 和 Partition 的数量都是固定的，只有副本数量随着节点数变化。&lt;/details&gt;&lt;/think&gt;\n\n---\n\n现在我完全看清楚了。让我重新正确解释：\n\n---\n\n## 源码流程\n\n### 1. 解析配置的地址列表\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\n// MetaDaemon.cpp 第 138 行\nauto peersRet = nebula::network::NetworkUtils::toHosts(FLAGS_meta_server_addrs);\n// 比如 \"192.168.1.1:9559,192.168.1.2:9559,192.168.1.3:9559\"\n// 解析成 [192.168.1.1:9559, 192.168.1.2:9559, 192.168.1.3:9559]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 传给 initKV\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\n// MetaDaemon.cpp 第 144 行\ngKVStore = initKV(peersRet.value(), localhost);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 创建唯一的 Space 和 Part\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\n// MetaDaemonInit.cpp 第 67-69 行\nauto partMan = std::make_unique&lt;nebula::kvstore::MemPartManager&gt;();\n// The meta server has only one space (0), one part (0)\npartMan-&gt;addPart(kDefaultSpaceId, kDefaultPartId, std::move(peers));\n//               Space=0         Part=0          peers=所有metad地址\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4.         "contents": "void RaftPart::start(std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt;&amp;&amp; peers, bool asLearner) {\n  std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; g(raftLock_);\n\n  // There are some rare cases that the part start as learner, but wal is not empty. For example,\n  // the node is dead, and one partition is removed from raft group (majority still alive). However,\n  // the part is added back to raft group again as learner. So the wal may be not empty, what is\n  // worse, there could be case that commitLogId is 0, but wal's lastLogId is not 0, which is\n  // obviously not expected\n  if (asLearner) {\n    wal_-&gt;reset();\n  }\n\n  lastLogId_ = wal_-&gt;lastLogId();\n  lastLogTerm_ = wal_-&gt;lastLogTerm();\n  term_ = lastLogTerm_;\n\n  // Set the quorum number\n  quorum_ = (peers.size() + 1) / 2;\n\n  auto logIdAndTerm = lastCommittedLogId();\n  committedLogId_ = logIdAndTerm.first;\n  committedLogTerm_ = logIdAndTerm.second;\n\n  if (lastLogId_ &lt; committedLogId_) {\n    VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Reset lastLogId \" &lt;&lt; lastLogId_ &lt;&lt; \" to be the committedLogId \"\n            &lt;&lt; committedLogId_;\n    lastLogId_ = committedLogId_;\n    lastLogTerm_ = committedLogTerm_;\n    wal_-&gt;reset();\n  }\n  VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"There are \" &lt;&lt; peers.size() &lt;&lt; \" peer hosts, and total \" &lt;&lt; peers.size() + 1\n          &lt;&lt; \" copies. The quorum is \" &lt;&lt; quorum_ + 1 &lt;&lt; \", as learner \" &lt;&lt; asLearner\n          &lt;&lt; \", lastLogId \" &lt;&lt; lastLogId_ &lt;&lt; \", lastLogTerm \" &lt;&lt; lastLogTerm_ &lt;&lt; \", committedLogId \"\n          &lt;&lt; committedLogId_ &lt;&lt; \", committedLogTerm \" &lt;&lt; committedLogTerm_ &lt;&lt; \", term \" &lt;&lt; term_;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**WAL 损坏检测和修复（&#96;FileBasedWal::scanLastWal()&#96;）:**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;371:440:src/kvstore/wal/FileBasedWal.cpp\nvoid FileBasedWal::scanLastWal(WalFileInfoPtr info, LogID firstId) {\n  auto* path = info-&gt;path();\n  int32_t fd = open(path, O_RDWR);",

        "contents": "# Metad 自动恢复机制源码深度分析\n\n## 一、核心结论\n\n### ✅ Metad 损坏时数据可以自动恢复\n\n**前提条件**：\n- **至少过半（多数派）metad 节点存活**（3节点集群至少2个存活，5节点集群至少3个存活）\n- 损坏节点可以重新启动并连接到集群\n\n**恢复方式**：\n1. **自动恢复**：通过 Raft 协议从其他节点同步数据\n2. **WAL 修复**：自动检测和修复损坏的 WAL 文件\n3. **快照恢复**：如果日志落后太多，从 Leader 接收快照\n\n## 二、源码流程分析\n\n### 2.1 启动时的恢复流程\n\n#### 步骤 1: NebulaStore 初始化\n\n**文件**: &#96;src/kvstore/NebulaStore.cpp:47-78&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\nbool NebulaStore::init() {\n  // 1. 启动 Raft 服务\n  raftService_ = raftex::RaftexService::createService(...);\n  \n  // 2. 从本地数据路径加载分区\n  loadPartFromDataPath();  // 从磁盘加载已有数据\n  \n  // 3. 从 PartManager 加载分区信息\n  loadPartFromPartManager();  // 从 meta 获取分区配置\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**关键点**：\n- &#96;loadPartFromDataPath()&#96; 会扫描本地数据目录，加载已有的分区数据\n- &#96;loadPartFromPartManager()&#96; 会从 meta 服务获取最新的分区配置\n- 两者结合确保本地数据和集群配置一致\n\n#### 步骤 2: RaftPart 启动\n\n**文件**: &#96;src/kvstore/raftex/RaftPart.cpp:400-454&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\nvoid RaftPart::start(std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt;&amp;&amp; peers, bool asLearner) {\n  // 1. 从 WAL 恢复日志状态\n  lastLogId_ = wal_-&gt;lastLogId();      // WAL 中最后一条日志 ID",

        "contents": "3. **peers 的数量 = 副本数量**\n\n所以 MetaD 的副本数不是通过单独的配置项设置的，而是由 &#96;meta_server_addrs&#96; 中配置了多少个地址来决定的！\n\n让我再看看 peers 是怎么传进来的。&lt;/details&gt;&lt;/think&gt;\n\n---\n\n**找到了！** 关键在第 39-43 行的注释：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\nDEFINE_string(meta_server_addrs,\n              \"\",\n              \"It is a list of IPs split by comma, used in cluster deployment\"\n              \"the ips number is equal to the replica number.\"  // ← 关键！\n              \"If empty, it means it's a single node\");\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n再看初始化逻辑：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\n// 第 68-69 行\n// The meta server has only one space (0), one part (0)\npartMan-&gt;addPart(nebula::kDefaultSpaceId, nebula::kDefaultPartId, std::move(peers));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 结论\n\n| 配置 | 含义 |\n|------|------|\n| &#96;meta_server_addrs=192.168.1.1:9559&#96; | **1 副本**（单节点） |\n| &#96;meta_server_addrs=192.168.1.1:9559,192.168.1.2:9559,192.168.1.3:9559&#96; | **3 副本** |\n\n---\n\n## MetaD vs StorageD 副本配置方式\n\n| 服务 | 副本数配置方式 |\n|------|---------------|\n| **MetaD** | &#96;meta_server_addrs&#96; 里写几个地址就是几副本 |\n| **StorageD** | &#96;CREATE SPACE&#96; 时指定 &#96;replica_factor&#96; |\n\n---\n\n## 源码验证\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\n// MetaDaemonInit.cpp 第 65-69 行\nstd::unique_ptr&lt;nebula::kvstore::KVStore&gt; initKV(\n    std::vector&lt;nebula::HostAddr&gt; peers,  // ← peers 数量 = 副本数\n    nebula::HostAddr localhost) {\n  \n  // MetaD 只有 1 个 space、1 个 partition\n  partMan-&gt;addPart(kDefaultSpaceId, kDefaultPartId, std::move(peers));\n  //                                                 ↑ peers 就是 Raft 组成员\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 一句话\n\n&gt; **MetaD 没有单独的 &#96;replica_factor&#96; 配置，它的副本数 = &#96;meta_server_addrs&#96; 里配置的地址数量。**\n\n配 1 个地址 = 1 副本 = 无高可用  \n配 3 个地址 = 3 副本 = Raft 生效\n\n---\n\n_**User**_\n\nmetad本身它既不分片，也没有副本？\n\n---\n\n_**Agent (model claude-4.5-opus-high-thinking, mode Agent)**_\n\n&lt;think&gt;&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;Thought Process&lt;/summary&gt;\n用户问 MetaD 本身是否分片和副本。让我仔细看看源码。",

          "endPosition": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "- 客户端可以连接**任意一个**\n- **无状态**：不存储数据，只做查询处理\n- 挂掉一个？连另一个就行，**无感知切换**\n\n### 2. Meta 层 —— **Raft 对称**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐\n│ MetaD   │  │ MetaD   │  │ MetaD   │\n│ Leader  │  │Follower │  │Follower │\n└─────────┘  └─────────┘  └─────────┘\n     │            │            │\n     └──── Raft 协议 ─────────┘\n         自动选举 Leader\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- 虽然有 Leader，但 **Leader 是动态选举的**\n- Leader 挂了？剩余节点**秒级自动选出新 Leader**\n- 对外看起来就像一个整体\n\n### 3. Storage 层 —— **分片对称**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n         Partition 1      Partition 2      Partition 3\n        ┌───────────┐    ┌───────────┐    ┌───────────┐\n节点 A  │  Leader   │    │  Follower │    │  Follower │\n        ├───────────┤    ├───────────┤    ├───────────┤\n节点 B  │  Follower │    │  Leader   │    │  Follower │\n        ├───────────┤    ├───────────┤    ├───────────┤\n节点 C  │  Follower │    │  Follower │    │  Leader   │\n        └───────────┘    └───────────┘    └───────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- 数据被切成多个 **Partition（分片）**\n- 每个分片有 **3 个副本**（可配置）\n- 每个分片独立选举 Leader\n- **负载均衡**：Leader 分散在不同节点上\n\n---\n\n## \"对称\"带来的好处\n\n| 好处 | 说明 |\n|------|------|\n| **无单点故障** | 任何一个节点挂了，服务继续 |\n| **水平扩展** | 加机器就能提升性能，线性扩展 |\n| **负载均衡** | 请求分散到所有节点 |",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# 测试 4: 多数派故障测试\ntest_majority_failure() {\n    log_info \"=== Test 4: Majority Failure Test ===\"\n    \n    # 停止多数派节点（3节点集群停止2个）\n    log_info \"Stopping majority of nodes...\"\n    stop_node ${META_PORTS[0]}\n    stop_node ${META_PORTS[1]}\n    \n    sleep 5\n    \n    # 检查剩余节点状态\n    if check_node_running ${META_PORTS[2]}; then\n        log_info \"Remaining node is still running (expected for minority)\"\n        log_info \"Checking if it can become leader...\"\n        # 在3节点集群中，1个节点无法形成多数派，应该无法成为leader\n    fi\n    \n    # 恢复节点\n    log_info \"Restoring nodes...\"\n    # ./scripts/nebula.service start metad-0\n    # ./scripts/nebula.service start metad-1\n    wait_for_node ${META_PORTS[0]}\n    wait_for_node ${META_PORTS[1]}\n    \n    log_info \"Test 4 completed\"\n}\n\n# 主函数\nmain() {\n    log_info \"Starting Metad Recovery Tests\"\n    log_info \"==============================\"\n    \n    # 检查必要的目录\n    if [ ! -d \"$META_DATA_DIR\" ]; then\n        log_error \"Meta data directory not found: $META_DATA_DIR\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    \n    # 运行测试\n    test_wal_corruption_recovery\n    echo \"\"\n    \n    test_rocksdb_corruption_recovery\n    echo \"\"\n    \n    test_node_restart_recovery\n    echo \"\"\n    \n    test_majority_failure\n    echo \"\"\n    \n    log_info \"All tests completed!\"\n    log_info \"Please check the logs in $META_LOG_DIR for detailed recovery information\"\n}\n\n# 执行主函数\nmain \"$@\"",

已修正文档中的错误表述。修正总结如下：

## 修正内容

### 错误表述（已修正）
- ❌ "至少有一个 metad 节点存活"
- ✅ "至少过半（多数派）metad 节点存活"

### 修正后的准确表述

**关键前提**：
- 至少过半（多数派）metad 节点存活
  - 3节点集群：至少需要 2个节点存活（2 > 3/2 = 1.5）
  - 5节点集群：至少需要 3个节点存活（3 > 5/2 = 2.5）
  - 公式：多数派 = ⌊N/2⌋ + 1，其中 N 是总节点数

**为什么需要多数派？**
- Raft 协议要求：只有多数派节点确认的日志才能被提交
- 任意两个多数派必有交集，保证已提交数据不会丢失
- 只有多数派存活才能选举出新的 Leader，保证服务可用

**多数派容错能力**：
- 3节点集群：最多允许 1个节点故障（需要2个存活 = 多数派）
- 5节点集群：最多允许 2个节点故障（需要3个存活 = 多数派）
- 7节点集群：最多允许 3个节点故障（需要4个存活 = 多数派）
- 公式：可容忍故障数 = ⌊N/2⌋，其中 N 是总节点数

### 已修正的文件

1. `docs/METAD_RECOVERY_SUMMARY.md` - 已修正
2. `docs/metad-auto-recovery-source-analysis.md` - 已修正

感谢指正。Raft 协议的核心要求是多数派（过半）节点存活，而不是“至少一个”。这样表述更准确，符合 Raft 的容错机制。

        "contents": "│  └─────────────┘  └─────────────┘  └─────────────┘         │\n│                                                             │\n│      100 个分片 × 每个 3 副本 = 300 个 Raft Group           │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 一句话总结\n\n| 服务 | 分片 | 副本 |\n|------|------|------|\n| **MetaD** | 不分片（固定 1 个 Partition） | **有副本**（= meta_server_addrs 地址数） |\n| **StorageD** | 分片（partition_num 可配） | 有副本（replica_factor 可配） |\n\n**MetaD 有副本！** 只是它不分片而已。配 3 个 meta 地址 = 3 副本 Raft 集群。\n\n---\n\n_**User**_\n\nspace和part有什么区别，简要\n\n---\n\n_**Agent (model claude-4.5-opus-high-thinking, mode Agent)**_\n\n&lt;think&gt;&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;Thought Process&lt;/summary&gt;\n用户想了解 Space 和 Part (Partition) 的区别。简要解释一下这两个概念。&lt;/details&gt;&lt;/think&gt;\n\n---\n\n## Space vs Partition 简要对比\n\n| 概念 | 类比 | 说明 |\n|------|------|------|\n| **Space** | 数据库 (Database) | 逻辑隔离单位，包含 Schema、数据 |\n| **Partition** | 分片 (Shard) | 物理存储单位，数据切分 |\n\n---\n\n## 关系\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nSpace (图空间)\n  └── Partition 0  ─┐\n  └── Partition 1   │  数据按 VID hash 分布到不同 Partition\n  └── Partition 2   │\n  └── ...          ─┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 一句话\n\n&gt; **Space 是逻辑概念（像 MySQL 的 database），Partition 是物理切分（数据分片）。**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- 创建 Space 时指定分片数\nCREATE SPACE test (\n    partition_num = 100,    -- 切成 100 个 Partition\n    replica_factor = 3      -- 每个 Partition 3 副本\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n_**User**_\n\n@src/kvstore/PartManager.h:275-291 这代码什么意思\n\n---",

        "contents": "│                                                                │\n│   Space = 0 (唯一)                                              │\n│   └── Partition = 0 (唯一)                                      │\n│           │                                                    │\n│           │  hosts_ = [meta1:9559, meta2:9559, meta3:9559]     │\n│           │             ↓           ↓           ↓              │\n│           │         ┌───────┐  ┌───────┐  ┌───────┐           │\n│           │         │ meta1 │  │ meta2 │  │ meta3 │           │\n│           │         │副本 1 │  │副本 2 │  │副本 3 │           │\n│           │         │Leader │  │Follower│ │Follower│           │\n│           │         └───────┘  └───────┘  └───────┘           │\n│           │              └──────────┴──────────┘               │\n│           │                    1 个 Raft Group                 │\n│                                                                │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 总结\n\n| 项目 | 数量 | 说明 |\n|------|------|------|\n| Space | **固定 1 个** | kDefaultSpaceId = 0 |\n| Partition | **固定 1 个** | kDefaultPartId = 0 |\n| 副本数 | **= MetaD 节点数** | hosts_.size() = meta_server_addrs 地址数 |\n| Raft Group | **1 个** | 所有 MetaD 节点组成 1 个 Raft Group |\n\n**&#96;hosts_&#96; 不是\"多个 Space/Part\"，而是\"1 个 Part 的多个副本所在的主机地址\"。**\n\n我之前说错了，抱歉！\n\n---\n\n_**User**_\n\nkvstore是什么一句话。仅仅是单机rk的封装，还是没有图语义的分布式kv存储（当然kv这块基于rk）\n\n---\n\n_**Agent (model claude-4.5-opus-high-thinking, mode Agent)**_",

        "contents": "########## basics ##########\n# Whether to run as a daemon process\n--daemonize=true\n# The file to host the process id\n--pid_file=pids/nebula-metad.pid\n\n########## logging ##########\n# The directory to host logging files\n--log_dir=logs\n# Log level, 0, 1, 2, 3 for INFO, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL respectively\n--minloglevel=0\n# Verbose log level, 1, 2, 3, 4, the higher of the level, the more verbose of the logging\n--v=0\n# Maximum seconds to buffer the log messages\n--logbufsecs=0\n# Whether to redirect stdout and stderr to separate output files\n--redirect_stdout=true\n# Destination filename of stdout and stderr, which will also reside in log_dir.\n--stdout_log_file=metad-stdout.log\n--stderr_log_file=metad-stderr.log\n# Copy log messages at or above this level to stderr in addition to logfiles. The numbers of severity levels INFO, WARNING, ERROR, and FATAL are 0, 1, 2, and 3, respectively.\n--stderrthreshold=3\n# wether logging files' name contain time stamp.\n--timestamp_in_logfile_name=true\n\n########## networking ##########\n# Comma separated Meta Server addresses\n--meta_server_addrs=192.168.2.1:9559\n# Local IP used to identify the nebula-metad process.\n# Change it to an address other than loopback if the service is distributed or\n# will be accessed remotely.\n--local_ip=192.168.2.1\n# Meta daemon listening port\n--port=9559\n# HTTP service ip\n--ws_ip=0.0.0.0\n# HTTP service port\n--ws_http_port=19559\n# Port to listen on Storage with HTTP protocol, it corresponds to ws_http_port in storage's configuration file\n--ws_storage_http_port=19779\n\n########## storage ##########\n# Root data path, here should be only single path for metad\n--data_path=data/meta\n\n########## Misc #########\n# The default number of parts when a space is created\n\n--default_parts_num=100\n# The default replica factor when a space is created\n--default_replica_factor=1\n\n--heartbeat_interval_secs=10\n--agent_heartbeat_interval_secs=60\n\n############## rocksdb Options ##############\n--rocksdb_wal_sync=true",

        "contents": "########## basics ##########\n# Whether to run as a daemon process\n--daemonize=true\n# The file to host the process id\n--pid_file=pids/nebula-metad.pid\n\n########## logging ##########\n# The directory to host logging files\n--log_dir=logs\n# Log level, 0, 1, 2, 3 for INFO, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL respectively\n--minloglevel=0\n# Verbose log level, 1, 2, 3, 4, the higher of the level, the more verbose of the logging\n--v=0\n# Maximum seconds to buffer the log messages\n--logbufsecs=0\n# Whether to redirect stdout and stderr to separate output files\n--redirect_stdout=true\n# Destination filename of stdout and stderr, which will also reside in log_dir.\n--stdout_log_file=metad-stdout.log\n--stderr_log_file=metad-stderr.log\n# Copy log messages at or above this level to stderr in addition to logfiles. The numbers of severity levels INFO, WARNING, ERROR, and FATAL are 0, 1, 2, and 3, respectively.\n--stderrthreshold=3\n# wether logging files' name contain time stamp, If Using logrotate to rotate logging files, than should set it to true.\n--timestamp_in_logfile_name=true\n\n########## networking ##########\n# Comma separated Meta Server addresses\n--meta_server_addrs=127.0.0.1:9559\n# Local IP used to identify the nebula-metad process.\n# Change it to an address other than loopback if the service is distributed or\n# will be accessed remotely.\n--local_ip=127.0.0.1\n# Meta daemon listening port\n--port=9559\n# HTTP service ip\n--ws_ip=0.0.0.0\n# HTTP service port\n--ws_http_port=19559\n# Port to listen on Storage with HTTP protocol, it corresponds to ws_http_port in storage's configuration file\n--ws_storage_http_port=19779\n\n########## storage ##########\n# Root data path, here should be only single path for metad\n--data_path=data/meta\n\n########## Misc #########\n# The default number of parts when a space is created\n--default_parts_num=100\n# The default replica factor when a space is created\n--default_replica_factor=1\n\n--heartbeat_interval_secs=10\n--agent_heartbeat_interval_secs=60",

      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {

        "contents": "########## basics ##########\n# Whether to run as a daemon process\n--daemonize=true\n# The file to host the process id\n--pid_file=pids/nebula-metad.pid\n\n########## logging ##########\n# The directory to host logging files\n--log_dir=logs\n# Log level, 0, 1, 2, 3 for INFO, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL respectively\n--minloglevel=0\n# Verbose log level, 1, 2, 3, 4, the higher of the level, the more verbose of the logging\n--v=0\n# Maximum seconds to buffer the log messages\n--logbufsecs=0\n# Whether to redirect stdout and stderr to separate output files\n--redirect_stdout=true\n# Destination filename of stdout and stderr, which will also reside in log_dir.\n--stdout_log_file=metad-stdout.log\n--stderr_log_file=metad-stderr.log\n# Copy log messages at or above this level to stderr in addition to logfiles. The numbers of severity levels INFO, WARNING, ERROR, and FATAL are 0, 1, 2, and 3, respectively.\n--stderrthreshold=3\n# wether logging files' name contain time stamp, If Using logrotate to rotate logging files, than should set it to true.\n--timestamp_in_logfile_name=true\n\n########## networking ##########\n# Comma separated Meta Server addresses\n--meta_server_addrs=127.0.0.1:9559\n# Local IP used to identify the nebula-metad process.\n# Change it to an address other than loopback if the service is distributed or\n# will be accessed remotely.\n--local_ip=127.0.0.1\n# Meta daemon listening port\n--port=9559\n# HTTP service ip\n--ws_ip=0.0.0.0\n# HTTP service port\n--ws_http_port=19559\n# Port to listen on Storage with HTTP protocol, it corresponds to ws_http_port in storage's configuration file\n--ws_storage_http_port=19779\n\n########## storage ##########\n# Root data path, here should be only single path for metad\n--data_path=data/meta\n\n########## Misc #########\n# The default number of parts when a space is created\n--default_parts_num=100\n# The default replica factor when a space is created\n--default_replica_factor=1\n\n--heartbeat_interval_secs=10\n--agent_heartbeat_interval_secs=60",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.specstory/history/2026-01-23_05-32Z-项目源码文件结构阅读指南.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 7731
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 7813
          }
        },
        "contents": "3. **peers 的数量 = 副本数量**\n\n所以 MetaD 的副本数不是通过单独的配置项设置的，而是由 &#96;meta_server_addrs&#96; 中配置了多少个地址来决定的！\n\n让我再看看 peers 是怎么传进来的。&lt;/details&gt;&lt;/think&gt;\n\n---\n\n**找到了！** 关键在第 39-43 行的注释：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\nDEFINE_string(meta_server_addrs,\n              \"\",\n              \"It is a list of IPs split by comma, used in cluster deployment\"\n              \"the ips number is equal to the replica number.\"  // ← 关键！\n              \"If empty, it means it's a single node\");\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n再看初始化逻辑：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\n// 第 68-69 行\n// The meta server has only one space (0), one part (0)\npartMan-&gt;addPart(nebula::kDefaultSpaceId, nebula::kDefaultPartId, std::move(peers));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 结论\n\n| 配置 | 含义 |\n|------|------|\n| &#96;meta_server_addrs=192.168.1.1:9559&#96; | **1 副本**（单节点） |\n| &#96;meta_server_addrs=192.168.1.1:9559,192.168.1.2:9559,192.168.1.3:9559&#96; | **3 副本** |\n\n---\n\n## MetaD vs StorageD 副本配置方式\n\n| 服务 | 副本数配置方式 |\n|------|---------------|\n| **MetaD** | &#96;meta_server_addrs&#96; 里写几个地址就是几副本 |\n| **StorageD** | &#96;CREATE SPACE&#96; 时指定 &#96;replica_factor&#96; |\n\n---\n\n## 源码验证\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\n// MetaDaemonInit.cpp 第 65-69 行\nstd::unique_ptr&lt;nebula::kvstore::KVStore&gt; initKV(\n    std::vector&lt;nebula::HostAddr&gt; peers,  // ← peers 数量 = 副本数\n    nebula::HostAddr localhost) {\n  \n  // MetaD 只有 1 个 space、1 个 partition\n  partMan-&gt;addPart(kDefaultSpaceId, kDefaultPartId, std::move(peers));\n  //                                                 ↑ peers 就是 Raft 组成员\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 一句话\n\n&gt; **MetaD 没有单独的 &#96;replica_factor&#96; 配置，它的副本数 = &#96;meta_server_addrs&#96; 里配置的地址数量。**\n\n配 1 个地址 = 1 副本 = 无高可用  \n配 3 个地址 = 3 副本 = Raft 生效\n\n---\n\n_**User**_\n\nmetad本身它既不分片，也没有副本？\n\n---\n\n_**Agent (model claude-4.5-opus-high-thinking, mode Agent)**_\n\n&lt;think&gt;&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;Thought Process&lt;/summary&gt;\n用户问 MetaD 本身是否分片和副本。让我仔细看看源码。",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "3. **peers 的数量 = 副本数量**",
            "lineNumber": 7732
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7733

        "contents": "| 原因 | 说明 |\n|------|------|\n| **开箱即用** | 单机也能跑，降低入门门槛 |\n| **节省资源** | 测试/开发环境不需要多副本 |\n| **用户自己定** | 生产环境由用户根据集群规模显式设置 |\n\n---\n\n## 实际生产建议\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- 创建 Space 时显式指定\nCREATE SPACE my_space (\n    partition_num = 100,\n    replica_factor = 3,    -- 生产环境用 3\n    vid_type = INT64\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 一句话\n\n&gt; **默认值是给单机/测试用的，生产环境必须自己设 &#96;replica_factor=3&#96;。**\n\n&#96;.production&#96; 配置只是个**模板**，不是最佳实践——真正部署时需要根据节点数调整。\n\n---\n\n_**User**_\n\n这是storaged的副本因子，那metad呢？给我好好从源码找\n\n---\n\n_**Agent (model claude-4.5-opus-high-thinking, mode Agent)**_\n\n&lt;think&gt;&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;Thought Process&lt;/summary&gt;\n用户问的很好！&#96;default_replica_factor&#96; 确实是创建 Space 时数据分片的副本因子，这是给 StorageD 用的。\n\n但是 MetaD 自身的副本数是怎么配置的呢？这是个不同的问题。MetaD 集群本身也用 Raft 来保证高可用，它的副本数是通过 &#96;meta_server_addrs&#96; 配置的节点数量来决定的。\n\n让我从源码找找 MetaD 自身 Raft 副本相关的配置。&lt;/details&gt;&lt;/think&gt;\n\n---\n\n好问题！你说得对，&#96;default_replica_factor&#96; 是给 **Storage 数据分片**用的。**MetaD 自身的副本数**是另一回事。让我从源码找。\n\n---\n\n&lt;tool-use data-tool-type=\"unknown\" data-tool-name=\"ripgrep_raw_search\"&gt;\n&lt;details&gt;\n&lt;summary&gt;Tool use: **ripgrep_raw_search**&lt;/summary&gt;\n\n\nParameters:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"pattern\": \"meta_server_addrs\",\n  \"path\": \"/usr/local/nebula/src\",\n  \"glob\": \"*.cpp\",\n  \"context\": 3,\n  \"caseInsensitive\": false\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nResult:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": {\n    \"pattern\": \"meta_server_addrs\",",

MetaDaemonInit.cpp 第 65-69 行：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\nstd::unique_ptr&lt;nebula::kvstore::KVStore&gt; initKV(std::vector&lt;nebula::HostAddr&gt; peers,                                                 nebula::HostAddr localhost) {\n  auto partMan = std::make_unique&lt;nebula::kvstore::MemPartManager&gt;();\n  // The meta server has only one space (0), one part (0)\n  partMan-&gt;addPart(nebula::kDefaultSpaceId, nebula::kDefaultPartId, std::move(peers));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n创建 MemPartManager，添加唯一的 Space 0 和 Part 0，**peers 作为这个 Part 的 hosts**。4. 后续 NebulaStore 初始化时，会为这个 Part 创建 RaftPart，peers 就是 Raft Group 的成员。\n\n所以正确的理解是：- MetaD 整个集群只有 **1 个 Space** (ID=0)- 只有 **1 个 Partition** (ID=0)\n- 这 **1 个 Partition 有 N 个副本**，分布在 N 个 MetaD 进程上\n\n\n- N 由 &#96;meta_server_addrs&#96; 中配置的地址数量决定，这 N 个副本共同组成一个 Raft Group。我之前说有多少个 MetaD 就有多少个 Space 和 Partition 是错的——实际上无论集群规模如何，Space 和 Partition 的数量都是固定的，只有副本数量随着节点数变化。&lt;/details&gt;&lt;/think&gt;\n\n---\n\n现在我完全看清楚了。让我重新正确解释：\n\n---",
